soru_metni: Paragraph: Many people believe that introverts lack social skills, but this is a misconception. Introverts simply recharge their energy by being alone, whereas extroverts gain energy from social interactions. Both personality types can be highly successful in communication. Question: According to the passage, the main difference between introverts and extroverts is ---.
secenekler: their level of communication skills
how they restore their personal energy
their ability to succeed in professional life
the amount of friends they prefer to have
their willingness to work in team environments
aciklama: Pasajda içe dönüklerin yalnız kalarak, dışa dönüklerin ise sosyal etkileşimlerle enerji topladığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, iki kişilik grubu arasındaki temel farkın enerjilerini nasıl geri kazandıkları olduğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Mars is often called the Red Planet because of the iron oxide on its surface, which gives it a reddish appearance. Although it has a very thin atmosphere, scientists believe that liquid water once flowed on Mars, making it a primary target for finding ancient life. Question: It is understood from the passage that Mars ---.
secenekler: has an atmosphere thick enough to support human life
is currently covered with large amounts of liquid water
is of great interest to scientists due to its geological past
obtained its reddish color from recent volcanic activities
is the only planet in the solar system with iron oxide
aciklama: Pasajda Mars'ta bir zamanlar sıvı suyun aktığına inanılmasının, onu antik yaşamı aramak için ana hedef haline getirdiği ifade edilmiştir. Bu durum, bilim insanlarının gezegenin geçmişine büyük bir ilgi duyduğunu doğrulamaktadır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Avocados are unique fruits because they are high in healthy fats rather than carbohydrates. They are rich in monounsaturated oleic acid, which is beneficial for heart health. Regular consumption of avocados can help lower bad cholesterol levels. Question: We can learn from the passage that avocados ---.
secenekler: contain more carbohydrates than most other fruits
should be avoided by people with heart conditions
are beneficial for cardiovascular health due to their fat content
are the only source of monounsaturated oleic acid
immediately eliminate cholesterol from the human body
aciklama: Metinde avokadonun kalp sağlığına faydalı olan tekli doymamış oleik asit bakımından zengin olduğu vurgulanmıştır. Bu yüzden düzenli tüketimi, kolesterolü düşürerek kalp-damar sağlığını olumlu etkiler.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Silk Road was not a single track but a network of trade routes connecting China with the Mediterranean. Apart from goods like silk and spices, it facilitated the exchange of ideas, religions, and technologies between Eastern and Western civilizations. Question: It can be inferred from the passage that the Silk Road ---.
secenekler: was used exclusively for transporting high-value spices
served as a cultural bridge between different civilizations
was established by Western empires to conquer China
lost its importance after the invention of sea trade
consisted of a single, well-maintained highway
aciklama: Pasajda İpek Yolu'nun sadece malları değil, aynı zamanda fikirleri, dinleri ve teknolojileri de taşıdığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, ticaret yolunun farklı medeniyetler arasında kültürel bir köprü görevi gördüğünü kanıtlar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Bees play a crucial role in our ecosystem by pollinating about one-third of the food we eat. However, their populations are declining rapidly due to habitat loss, pesticide use, and climate change. Without bees, global food security would be severely threatened. Question: According to the passage, the extinction of bees would ---.
secenekler: have little impact on the global agricultural sector
help plants grow more naturally without disruption
pose a significant danger to the world's food supply
force humans to rely entirely on artificial pollination
reduce the negative effects of global climate change
aciklama: Pasajda arıların yediğimiz besinlerin üçte birini döllediği ve yok olmalarının küresel gıda güvenliğini ciddi şekilde tehdit edeceği belirtilmiştir. Dolayısıyla, arıların yok olması dünya gıda arzı için büyük bir tehlike yaratacaktır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Sleep is essential for cognitive functions because it allows the brain to consolidate memories and clear out metabolic waste. Chronic sleep deprivation can lead to long-term issues such as memory loss, difficulty focusing, and a weakened immune system. Question: The passage mainly argues that ---.
secenekler: the brain stops working entirely during deep sleep
a lack of sleep can severely affect brain performance and health
dreaming is the most important part of the sleep cycle
eight hours of sleep is required for every individual
metabolic waste can only be cleared by medical treatments
aciklama: Metinde uykunun hafızayı güçlendirme ve atıkları temizleme gibi bilişsel işlevler için şart olduğu, uykusuzluğun ise odaklanma sorunları ve hafıza kaybına yol açtığı açıklanmıştır. Bu durum, yetersiz uykunun beyin performansı ve genel sağlık üzerinde ciddi olumsuz etkileri olduğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Mary Shelley wrote her famous novel Frankenstein when she was only nineteen years old. It was published anonymously in 1818, and many readers initially assumed it was written by her husband, Percy Shelley. Today, it is recognized as one of the earliest science fiction novels. Question: It is clear from the passage that Frankenstein ---.
secenekler: was written by Percy Shelley instead of Mary Shelley
did not receive any public attention when it was first published
is widely accepted as a pioneering work of science fiction
was openly published under Mary Shelley's name in 1818
took Mary Shelley decades to complete and refine
aciklama: Pasajda eserin günümüzde ilk bilimkurgu romanlarından biri olarak kabul edildiği belirtilmektedir. Bu nedenle, Mary Shelley'nin bu eseri türünün öncü örneklerinden biri olarak değer görmektedir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has transformed the medical field by analyzing large datasets to detect patterns that humans might miss. AI tools can now diagnose certain diseases, like skin cancer, with accuracy rates that match or even exceed those of experienced doctors. Question: According to the passage, AI in medicine ---.
secenekler: has completely replaced doctors in all healthcare departments
can identify specific illnesses by analyzing complex data
is too expensive to be used in standard public hospitals
regularly makes critical errors that humans easily avoid
focuses only on the treatment of various skin conditions
aciklama: Pasajda yapay zekanın büyük veri setlerindeki kalıpları analiz ederek bazı hastalıkları teşhis edebildiği ifade edilmiştir. Bu durum, yapay zekanın karmaşık verileri inceleyerek belirli hastalıkları tanıma gücünü ortaya koymaktadır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Antibiotic resistance occurs when bacteria mutate and become immune to the drugs designed to kill them. This crisis is largely driven by the overuse of antibiotics in both human medicine and agriculture, making common infections harder to treat. Question: One can understand from the passage that antibiotic resistance ---.
secenekler: is a natural process that cannot be stopped or slowed down
makes modern agricultural practices much safer for humans
results from bacteria adapting to survive against antibiotics
can be easily cured by increasing the dosage of the drugs
is caused exclusively by the poor hygiene of patients
aciklama: Metinde bakterilerin mutasyona uğrayarak kendilerini öldürmek için tasarlanan ilaçlara karşı bağışıklık kazandığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, antibiyotik direncinin bakterilerin hayatta kalma adaptasyonunun bir sonucu olduğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Inflation reduces the purchasing power of money, meaning that consumers can buy fewer goods with the same amount of cash. Central banks try to control inflation by raising interest rates, which discourages borrowing and slows down economic activity. Question: According to the passage, raising interest rates is a method used to ---.
secenekler: encourage consumers to borrow more money from banks
increase the total purchasing power of the national currency
reduce inflation by cooling down the overall economy
speed up economic activities during times of recession
help businesses expand their production capacities quickly
aciklama: Pasajda merkez bankalarının faiz oranlarını artırarak borçlanmayı azalttığı ve ekonomik faaliyeti yavaşlatıp enflasyonu kontrol etmeye çalıştığı belirtilmiştir. Bu doğrultuda, faiz artışı ekonomiyi sakinleştirerek enflasyonu düşürmeyi amaçlayan bir araçtır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Photosynthesis is the process by which plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to create oxygen and energy in the form of sugar. This process is vital for life on Earth, as it provides the oxygen that most living organisms need to breathe. Question: The passage points out that photosynthesis ---.
secenekler: can occur in the absence of water and carbon dioxide
produces carbon dioxide as a primary waste product
is the main source of oxygen for life on Earth
is performed by all living organisms to generate sugar
requires artificial light sources to be fully effective
aciklama: Metinde fotosentezin çoğu canlının nefes almak için ihtiyaç duyduğu oksijeni sağladığı ve Dünya'daki yaşam için hayati önem taşıdığı ifade edilmiştir. Bu yüzden, bu süreç yeryüzündeki oksijenin en temel kaynağıdır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The human heart beats about 100,000 times a day, pumping blood through a network of vessels that spans over 60,000 miles. This constant circulation delivers oxygen and nutrients to tissues while carrying away waste products like carbon dioxide. Question: According to the passage, the circulatory system ---.
secenekler: stops functioning when the body is in a state of deep sleep
is responsible for both nutrient delivery and waste removal
has a network of vessels that is shorter than previously thought
pumps blood only to the major organs of the human body
produces carbon dioxide to feed vital tissues and muscles
aciklama: Pasajda dolaşımın dokulara oksijen ve besin taşırken, karbondioksit gibi atık maddeleri de uzaklaştırdığı belirtilmiştir. Dolayısıyla, dolaşım sistemi hem besin dağıtımı hem de atıkların vücuttan temizlenmesi görevini üstlenir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Urbanization has led to the rapid growth of cities, but it also presents major challenges, such as housing shortages and pollution. To build sustainable cities, urban planners must focus on green spaces and efficient public transport systems. Question: The author suggests that in order to make cities sustainable, planners should ---.
secenekler: encourage more people to migrate from rural areas
prioritize environmental areas and public transit
stop the construction of new high-rise buildings
focus entirely on industrial growth and expansion
reduce the number of parks to create more housing
aciklama: Pasajda sürdürülebilir şehirler inşa etmek için yeşil alanlara ve verimli toplu taşıma sistemlerine odaklanılması gerektiği söylenmiştir. Bu öneri, şehir planlamacılarının çevre dostu alanlar ile toplu taşımayı önceliklendirmesi gerektiği anlamına gelir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Water is unique because it is one of the few substances on Earth that is less dense as a solid than as a liquid. This is why ice floats. If ice sank, lakes and oceans would freeze solid from the bottom up, destroying marine ecosystems. Question: According to the passage, the floating of ice ---.
secenekler: prevents aquatic life from being destroyed by freezing
is a common property shared by almost all chemical liquids
causes oceans to lose their water levels during the winter
is due to its high density compared to liquid water
makes it difficult for marine plants to perform photosynthesis
aciklama: Pasajda buzun batması durumunda göllerin ve okyanusların dipten başlayarak tamamen donacağı ve deniz ekosistemlerinin yok olacağı belirtilmiştir. Bu nedenle buzun yüzmesi, su altındaki yaşamın donarak yok olmasını engeller.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Chronic stress triggers the release of cortisol, a hormone that prepares the body for a "fight or flight" response. While useful in short bursts, prolonged high levels of cortisol can damage blood vessels and increase the risk of heart disease. Question: We can understand from the passage that cortisol ---.
secenekler: should be completely eliminated from the human body
has only negative effects on human health and survival
can cause physical harm if it remains elevated for too long
is produced in the brain to prevent the fight or flight response
helps repair damaged blood vessels in stressful situations
aciklama: Metinde kortizolün kısa süreli durumlarda faydalı olduğu, ancak uzun süreli yüksek seviyelerinin damarlara zarar verip kalp hastalığı riskini artırdığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, hormonun uzun süre yüksek kalmasının fiziksel zararlara yol açabileceğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The invention of the printing press by Johannes Gutenberg in the 15th century revolutionized communication. By making books affordable, it dramatically increased literacy rates across Europe and facilitated the rapid spread of scientific knowledge. Question: It is stated in the passage that the printing press ---.
secenekler: had a negative impact on the writing quality of books
made literature accessible only to the wealthy elite
played a key role in spreading science and education
was invented to replace handwritten religious documents
limited the exchange of ideas among European countries
aciklama: Pasajda matbaanın kitapları ucuzlatarak okuryazarlığı artırdığı ve bilimsel bilginin hızla yayılmasını sağladığı ifade edilmiştir. Bu yüzden matbaa, bilim ve eğitimin yaygınlaşmasında kritik bir rol oynamıştır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: El Niño is a climate pattern characterized by the warming of surface waters in the eastern Pacific Ocean. This warming disrupts global weather systems, causing severe droughts in some parts of the world and heavy flooding in others. Question: According to the passage, El Niño ---.
secenekler: is a local phenomenon that only affects Pacific islands
leads to uniform weather conditions across the globe
causes extreme and contrasting weather events worldwide
is caused by the cooling of oceans in the Western Pacific
has been completely controlled by modern meteorologists
aciklama: Pasajda El Niño'nun küresel hava sistemlerini bozarak dünyanın bazı bölgelerinde kuraklığa, bazı bölgelerinde ise şiddetli sellere yol açtığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, olayın dünya genelinde aşırı ve birbirine zıt hava olaylarına neden olduğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Laptops and smartphones emit blue light, which tricks the brain into thinking it is still daytime. This suppresses the production of melatonin, a hormone necessary for sleep, making it harder for people to fall asleep at night. Question: The passage suggests that using electronic devices before bed ---.
secenekler: increases melatonin production, helping users sleep better
makes the brain believe that it is not yet time to sleep
should be encouraged to reduce night-time anxiety
has no measurable impact on a person's sleep quality
is beneficial for people suffering from chronic insomnia
aciklama: Pasajda mavi ışığın beyni hala gündüz olduğuna inandırarak kandırdığı ve melatonini baskıladığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, uyumadan önce cihaz kullanmanın beynin henüz uyku vaktinin gelmediğini düşünmesine yol açtığını gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The nomadic lifestyle of ancient humans required them to move constantly in search of food and water. The transition to agriculture around 10,000 years ago allowed people to build permanent settlements, leading to the birth of early civilizations. Question: According to the passage, the development of agriculture ---.
secenekler: forced humans to adopt a more active, nomadic lifestyle
occurred because ancient people ran out of wild animals to hunt
enabled humans to settle in one place and establish societies
delayed the progress of human civilization for thousands of years
was first discovered by nomads who traveled across oceans
aciklama: Pasajda tarıma geçişin insanların kalıcı yerleşimler kurmasını sağladığı ve bunun da erken medeniyetlerin doğuşuna yol açtığı belirtilmiştir. Bu doğrultuda tarım, insanların yerleşik hayata geçmesini ve toplumlar kurmasını mümkün kılmıştır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Deforestation in the Amazon rainforest reduces the earth's capacity to absorb carbon dioxide. Because trees absorb this greenhouse gas during photosynthesis, destroying them accelerates global warming and threatens biodiversity. Question: It can be inferred from the passage that destroying the Amazon rainforest ---.
secenekler: helps plants perform photosynthesis more effectively
reduces the total amount of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere
speeds up the process of global climate change
has a positive impact on the survival of animal species
is necessary to create more agricultural land for local people
aciklama: Metinde ağaçların yok edilmesinin karbondioksit emilimini azaltarak küresel ısınmayı hızlandırdığı belirtilmiştir. Amazon ormanlarının yok edilmesi bu nedenle küresel iklim değişikliği sürecini hızlandıracaktır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Vaccines work by introducing a weakened or inactive part of a pathogen into the body. This trains the immune system to recognize and fight the virus in the future, providing protection without causing the actual disease. Question: According to the passage, vaccines protect people by ---.
secenekler: curing the disease after a person is already infected
teaching the body how to defend itself against future infections
killing the harmful viruses directly inside the bloodstream
replacing the body's natural immune system with chemicals
preventing any foreign pathogens from entering the body
aciklama: Pasajda aşıların bağışıklık sistemini virüsü tanımak ve onunla savaşmak üzere eğittiği ifade edilmiştir. Bu yüzden aşılar, vücuda gelecekteki enfeksiyonlara karşı kendini nasıl savunacağını öğreterek koruma sağlar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Impressionism, which began in France in the late 19th century, rejected traditional painting techniques. Instead of focusing on realistic details, impressionist artists tried to capture the shifting effects of light and color in everyday scenes. Question: One can understand from the passage that Impressionist painters ---.
secenekler: aimed to depict their subjects with extreme realism and detail
preferred to paint historical and mythological events
were deeply interested in how light changed the appearance of scenes
only used traditional methods approved by French academies
avoided painting outdoor scenes and everyday life
aciklama: Pasajda izlenimci sanatçıların gerçekçi detaylar yerine ışık ve rengin değişen etkilerini yakalamaya çalıştıkları belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, onların ışığın sahneler üzerindeki etkileriyle yakından ilgilendiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Gravity is the invisible force that pulls objects toward each other. The strength of gravity depends on the mass of the objects and the distance between them; the more massive an object is, the stronger its gravitational pull. Question: According to the passage, the gravitational force of an object ---.
secenekler: is completely independent of the object's physical mass
increases as the object becomes larger and heavier
becomes stronger as the distance between two objects increases
cannot be measured by modern scientific instruments
is only present on planets that have a thick atmosphere
aciklama: Pasajda bir nesne ne kadar büyük ve ağır (massive) olursa, kütleçekim kuvvetinin de o kadar güçlü olacağı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, kütleçekim kuvvetinin nesnenin kütlesi arttıkça arttığını doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The brain's ability to reorganize itself by forming new neural connections throughout life is called neuroplasticity. This process allows the brain to compensate for injury, adapt to new situations, and store new information. Question: According to the passage, neuroplasticity is important because it ---.
secenekler: prevents the brain from suffering any physical injuries
allows the brain to change and adapt to new experiences
stops the aging process of neural cells permanently
makes it impossible for humans to forget past memories
only functions during the very early stages of childhood
aciklama: Pasajda nöroplastisitenin beynin yeni bağlantılar kurarak kendini yeniden organize etmesini, yaralanmaları telafi etmesini ve yeni durumlara uyum sağlamasını mümkün kıldığı belirtilmiştir. Bu özellik, beynin yeni deneyimlere göre değişip adapte olmasını sağlar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The term "globalization" refers to the increasing integration of economies, cultures, and populations worldwide. While it has boosted international trade and cultural exchange, critics argue that it has also led to the loss of local traditions. Question: According to the passage, globalization ---.
secenekler: has had exclusively positive outcomes for all countries
is a threat to global trade and economic integration
has contributed to the decline of unique local cultures
was first introduced to protect traditional heritages
is no longer a relevant concept in the modern world
aciklama: Metinde eleştirmenlerin küreselleşmenin yerel geleneklerin kaybolmasına yol açtığını savundukları belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, küreselleşmenin özgün yerel kültürlerin zayıflamasına zemin hazırladığını doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Mariana Trench in the Pacific Ocean is the deepest known point on Earth. Despite the extreme pressure and complete lack of sunlight, unique organisms, such as giant amphipods, have adapted to survive in this harsh environment. Question: It can be inferred from the passage that life in the Mariana Trench ---.
secenekler: is impossible due to the intense pressure and darkness
consists only of species that migrated from shallow waters
exists because some organisms developed special survival adaptations
is highly dependent on plants that perform photosynthesis
is very similar to the life found on the ocean's surface
aciklama: Pasajda aşırı basınç ve güneş ışığı eksikliğine rağmen, benzersiz organizmaların bu zorlu ortamda hayatta kalmak için adapte olduğu belirtilmiştir. Bu, derinliklerdeki yaşamın özel hayatta kalma mekanizmaları geliştiren canlılar sayesinde sürdüğünü gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Type 2 diabetes is a chronic condition that affects how the body processes blood sugar. Unlike Type 1 diabetes, which is genetic, Type 2 is often preventable as it is closely linked to obesity, poor diet, and a lack of exercise. Question: The passage draws a contrast between Type 1 and Type 2 diabetes by stating that Type 2 ---.
secenekler: is entirely determined by a person's genetic background
can often be avoided through healthy lifestyle choices
is much harder to treat than the genetic Type 1 form
does not affect the body's processing of blood sugar
is a temporary condition that cures itself over time
aciklama: Pasajda Tip 2 diyabetin obezite, kötü beslenme ve hareketsizlikle bağlantılı olduğu ve genellikle önlenebilir olduğu belirtilmiştir. Bu yönüyle, Tip 2 diyabet sağlıklı yaşam tarzı seçimleriyle büyük oranda engellenebilir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Languages are dying out at an alarming rate; scientists estimate that half of the world's 7,000 languages will disappear by the end of this century. When a language dies, unique cultural knowledge, oral histories, and traditions are lost forever. Question: The author of the passage is concerned about the disappearance of languages because ---.
secenekler: it makes international business communication much harder
it leads to the loss of irreplaceable cultural heritage
learning new languages is essential for brain health
most disappearing languages are highly complex to study
it forces all countries to adopt a single global language
aciklama: Pasajda bir dil öldüğünde benzersiz kültürel bilgilerin, sözlü tarihlerin ve geleneklerin sonsuza dek kaybolduğu belirtilmiştir. Bu nedenle dillerin yok olması, telafi edilemez bir kültürel miras kaybına yol açmaktadır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Black holes are regions of space where gravity is so strong that nothing, not even light, can escape. They are formed when massive stars collapse at the end of their life cycle, creating an incredibly dense point in space. Question: According to the passage, black holes are created when ---.
secenekler: planets collide with each other in distant galaxies
very large stars die and collapse under their own gravity
light is trapped in a region with extremely low density
modern scientists conduct high-energy physics experiments
gravity in a region of space suddenly disappears
aciklama: Pasajda kara deliklerin, büyük yıldızların yaşam döngülerinin sonunda kendi içlerine çökmesiyle oluştuğu ifade edilmiştir. Bu sebeple, çok büyük yıldızların ölümü ve çöküşü kara deliklerin oluşum nedenidir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Drinking enough water is crucial for kidney function. The kidneys filter waste products from the blood and excrete them in urine; without adequate hydration, these wastes can build up and lead to painful kidney stones. Question: It can be concluded from the passage that dehydration ---.
secenekler: increases the kidneys' ability to filter blood quickly
is the primary cause of high blood pressure in adults
can lead to the accumulation of waste and kidney stones
is beneficial for removing metabolic waste from tissues
can be completely cured by reducing salt consumption
aciklama: Pasajda yeterli su tüketilmediğinde atıkların birikebileceği ve ağrılı böbrek taşlarına yol açabileceği belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, susuz kalmanın vücutta atık birikimine ve böbrek taşı oluşumuna yol açabileceğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Ancient Roman concrete was remarkably durable, allowing structures like the Pantheon to survive for two millennia. Modern research reveals that the Romans used volcanic ash in their mix, which allowed the concrete to heal its own cracks over time. Question: According to the passage, the longevity of Roman structures is due to ---.
secenekler: the dry climate of the regions where they were built
a special ingredient in their concrete that repairs damage
constant maintenance by modern archaeological teams
the massive size and thickness of their stone walls
the import of high-quality cement from Eastern Asia
aciklama: Pasajda Romalıların beton karışımlarında volkanik kül kullandıkları ve bu sayede betonun zamanla kendi çatlaklarını onarabildiği belirtilmiştir. Bu kendi kendini onarma özelliği, Roma yapılarının binlerce yıl hayatta kalmasını sağlamıştır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: 3D printing technology is transforming manufacturing by building objects layer by layer from digital models. This process reduces waste, as it only uses the exact amount of material needed, making it more eco-friendly than traditional methods. Question: According to the passage, a major environmental benefit of 3D printing is that ---.
secenekler: it uses only recycled plastic as its main raw material
it generates less material waste than older manufacturing ways
it does not require any electricity to operate the machines
it allows companies to produce goods much faster
it eliminates the need for transporting finished products
aciklama: Pasajda 3D yazıcıların nesneleri katman katman inşa ettiği ve sadece ihtiyaç duyulan miktarda malzeme kullanarak israfı azalttığı belirtilmiştir. Bu yönüyle teknoloji, geleneksel yöntemlere kıyasla daha az atık üreterek çevre dostu bir alternatif sunar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Regular aerobic exercise, such as running or swimming, strengthens the heart muscle and improves lung capacity. Additionally, it stimulates the release of endorphins, chemicals in the brain that act as natural painkillers and mood elevators. Question: According to the passage, aerobic exercise benefits the body by ---.
secenekler: reducing the brain's reliance on chemical endorphins
strengthening both physical organs and mental well-being
curing chronic physical pain without any medical help
replacing the need for a healthy, balanced diet
decreasing the heart rate to dangerously low levels
aciklama: Metinde aerobik egzersizin kalp ve akciğeri güçlendirdiği, ayrıca endorfin salgılanmasını tetikleyerek ruh halini iyileştirdiği belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, egzersizin hem fiziksel organlara hem de zihinsel sağlığa fayda sağladığını gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The ancient city of Pompeii was buried under volcanic ash when Mount Vesuvius erupted in 79 AD. Because the ash preserved the buildings and even the shapes of the victims, Pompeii provides historians with an incredibly detailed view of daily Roman life. Question: The passage points out that the eruption of Mount Vesuvius ---.
secenekler: destroyed all historical evidence of ancient Roman culture
occurred before the Romans had established a stable civilization
accidentally preserved a detailed record of Roman everyday life
forced the Roman Empire to relocate its capital city to the south
was predicted by local scientists who warned the population
aciklama: Pasajda volkanik külün binaları ve kurbanların şekillerini koruduğu, bu sayede Pompeii'nin tarihçilere Roma günlük yaşamına dair son derece detaylı bir görünüm sunduğu belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, felaketin dolaylı olarak Roma yaşamına dair kanıtları günümüze kadar sakladığını gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Invasive species are animals or plants introduced to a new environment where they have no natural predators. They often multiply rapidly, outcompeting native species for resources and causing severe damage to the local ecosystem. Question: According to the passage, invasive species cause harm because they ---.
secenekler: struggle to adapt to the climate of their new habitats
are easily hunted by native predators in the area
consume resources faster than native species can survive
slow down the reproduction rates of all local animals
introduce dangerous chemicals into the local water supply
aciklama: Pasajda istilacı türlerin yeni ortamlarında doğal avcıları olmadığı için hızla çoğaldıkları ve kaynaklar için yerli türlerle rekabet ederek ekosisteme zarar verdikleri belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, onların yerli türlerin kaynaklarını tüketerek zarar verdiklerini gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The liver is a vital organ that performs over 500 tasks, including detoxifying harmful chemicals, producing bile for digestion, and storing vitamins. It is also the only internal organ in the human body that can regenerate itself completely. Question: We can learn from the passage that the liver ---.
secenekler: is the largest internal organ but has very few functions
possesses the unique ability to regain damaged tissue
is the only organ responsible for digesting carbohydrates
can survive without storing vitamins or producing bile
is highly sensitive and cannot recover from minor injuries
aciklama: Pasajda karaciğerin vücutta kendi kendini tamamen yenileyebilen (regenerate) tek iç organ olduğu belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, karaciğerin hasarlı dokularını yeniden büyüterek kendini onarma yeteneğine sahip olduğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The bystander effect is a psychological phenomenon where individuals are less likely to help a victim when other people are present. Each person assumes someone else will take action, leading to a diffusion of responsibility and delayed help. Question: According to the passage, the bystander effect occurs because ---.
secenekler: people in large groups are naturally cruel and unhelpful
individuals assume that others will step in and help
victims usually refuse assistance from strangers
bystanders do not realize that an emergency is happening
laws forbid citizens from interfering in public accidents
aciklama: Pasajda her bireyin bir başkasının harekete geçeceğini varsaydığı ve sorumluluğun dağılması nedeniyle yardımın geciktiği belirtilmiştir. Bu nedenle, kalabalık ortamda herkes yardımı başkasının yapacağını düşündüğü için eylemsizlik yaşanır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Solar energy is a clean, renewable source of power, but its main limitation is intermittency. Since solar panels cannot generate electricity at night or during cloudy weather, efficient battery storage systems are necessary to make it reliable. Question: According to the passage, the primary challenge of relying on solar energy is that ---.
secenekler: it is more expensive to produce than fossil fuels
solar panels cause severe damage to the environment
it is not constantly available due to weather and time
the technology required to capture sunlight is outdated
it can only be used in regions close to the equator
aciklama: Pasajda güneş enerjisinin en büyük kısıtlamasının kesintili olması (intermittency) olduğu, gece veya bulutlu havalarda elektrik üretemediği söylenmiştir. Bu durum, güneş enerjisinin hava durumu ve zamana bağlı olarak sürekli kullanılamamasını en büyük zorluk haline getirir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Aspirin, originally derived from the bark of willow trees, has been used for centuries to treat pain and reduce fever. In modern medicine, low doses of aspirin are also prescribed to prevent blood clots and lower the risk of heart attacks. Question: It can be understood from the passage that modern doctors prescribe aspirin to ---.
secenekler: cure genetic heart diseases in young children
help reduce the likelihood of cardiovascular events
replace other stronger painkilling medications
treat infections caused by harmful bacteria
increase the clotting speed of blood in open wounds
aciklama: Pasajda düşük dozda aspirinin kan pıhtılaşmasını önlemek ve kalp krizi riskini azaltmak için reçete edildiği belirtilmiştir. Dolayısıyla modern tıpta aspirin, kalp ve damar kaynaklı olumsuz olayların olasılığını düşürmek için kullanılır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Magna Carta, signed in England in 1215, limited the absolute power of the king for the first time. By establishing that everyone, including the monarch, was subject to the law, it laid the foundation for modern democratic systems. Question: According to the passage, the Magna Carta was significant because it ---.
secenekler: abolished the monarchy in England and established a republic
made the king of England the sole ruler of Western Europe
declared that even the ruler must follow the laws of the country
allowed citizens to vote for their leaders for the first time
was written to protect the rights of foreign traders in England
aciklama: Pasajda Magna Carta'nın kral dahil herkesin hukuka tabi olduğunu belirlediği ve kralın mutlak gücünü ilk kez sınırladığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, belgenin yöneticinin de yasalara uyması gerektiğini kabul ettirmesi açısından önemli olduğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: In 2006, the International Astronomical Union reclassified Pluto as a "dwarf planet." This decision was made because Pluto has not "cleared its neighborhood" of other objects, meaning it shares its orbit with many Kuiper Belt asteroids. Question: According to the passage, Pluto lost its status as a full planet because ---.
secenekler: it is too far from the Sun to receive any warmth
its orbit is too unstable to be predicted by scientists
it has not cleared other objects out of its orbital path
it was discovered to be made entirely of frozen gases
it is much smaller than the Moon of the Earth
aciklama: Pasajda Plüton'un yörüngesindeki diğer nesneleri temizlememiş olması nedeniyle cüce gezegen sınıfına alındığı belirtilmiştir. Bu sebeple, yörüngesini asteroitlerle paylaşması tam gezegen statüsünü kaybetme gerekçesidir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Fermented foods like yogurt and kimchi are rich in probiotics, which are live bacteria that support gut health. A healthy gut microbiome is linked to improved digestion, a stronger immune system, and even better mental health. Question: The passage suggests that consuming fermented foods can ---.
secenekler: eliminate the need for digestive enzymes in the stomach
support the body's natural defenses and digestion
cure severe mental illnesses without therapy
cause harmful bacteria to multiply in the stomach
reduce the absorption of vitamins from other meals
aciklama: Pasajda probiyotik içeren fermente gıdaların bağırsak sağlığını desteklediği, bunun da sindirimi iyileştirdiği ve bağışıklık sistemini güçlendirdiği ifade edilmiştir. Bu yüzden, fermente gıdaların tüketimi sindirime ve vücut savunmasına katkı sağlar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The barter system was the earliest form of trade, where people directly exchanged goods they had for goods they needed. However, this system was inefficient because it required a "coincidence of wants"—both parties had to desire what the other was offering. Question: According to the passage, the barter system was inefficient because ---.
secenekler: it was difficult to transport heavy goods over long distances
people did not have a common understanding of fairness
it depended on both traders wanting what the other person possessed
ancient governments collected high taxes on exchanged items
it was quickly replaced by gold and silver coins in Europe
aciklama: Metinde takas sisteminin verimsizliğinin "isteklerin uyuşması" (coincidence of wants) zorunluluğundan, yani her iki tarafın da karşıdakinin sunduğu malı istemesinden kaynaklandığı söylenmiştir. Bu durum, ticaretin gerçekleşmesi için iki tarafın da karşılıklı olarak birbirinin mallarına ihtiyaç duyması gerektiği anlamına gelir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Coral reefs are often called the rainforests of the sea because they support immense biodiversity. However, rising ocean temperatures cause coral bleaching, a process where corals expel the algae that feed them, leading to their death. Question: It can be inferred from the passage that coral bleaching is caused by ---.
secenekler: the excessive growth of algae on the ocean floor
changes in ocean temperatures due to global warming
invasive fish species that feed on the coral reefs
a lack of sunlight reaching the deep parts of the sea
toxic chemical pollution from coastal factories
aciklama: Pasajda okyanus sıcaklıklarının yükselmesinin mercanların beyazlaşmasına (bleaching) yol açtığı ve bu süreçte besleyici alglerin dışarı atıldığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, beyazlaşmanın sıcaklık artışı nedeniyle tetiklendiğini doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The placebo effect occurs when a patient experiences a real improvement in their condition after receiving an inactive treatment, like a sugar pill. This psychological phenomenon demonstrates the powerful connection between expectation and physical healing. Question: The placebo effect shows that ---.
secenekler: modern chemical medicines are no longer necessary for healing
a patient's beliefs and expectations can influence physical health
sugar pills have hidden medical properties that doctors use
patients frequently lie about their symptoms to please doctors
the brain cannot distinguish between pain and pleasure
aciklama: Metinde placebo etkisinin, hastanın aktif olmayan bir tedavi aldığında bile iyileşme yaşamasıyla görüldüğü ve bunun beklenti ile fiziksel iyileşme arasındaki güçlü bağı gösterdiği söylenmiştir. Bu durum, inanç ve beklentilerin fiziksel sağlık üzerinde doğrudan bir etkiye sahip olabileceğini kanıtlar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: During the Renaissance, artists developed linear perspective, a mathematical system for creating the illusion of three-dimensional space on a flat surface. This technique completely transformed European painting, making scenes look realistic and lifelike. Question: According to the passage, linear perspective allowed Renaissance artists to ---.
secenekler: paint outdoor scenes much faster than before
create a sense of depth and realism on flat canvases
avoid using expensive color pigments in their artworks
depict historical events without checking their accuracy
hide secret messages inside religious paintings
aciklama: Pasajda doğrusal perspektifin düz bir yüzeyde üç boyutlu alan illüzyonu yaratan matematiksel bir sistem olduğu ve resimleri gerçekçi kıldığı belirtilmiştir. Dolayısıyla bu teknik, düz tuvaller üzerinde derinlik ve gerçekçilik hissi yaratılmasını sağlamıştır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The extinction of non-avian dinosaurs about 66 million years ago is widely believed to have been caused by a massive asteroid impact. The collision threw dust and debris into the atmosphere, blocking sunlight and causing a global winter that collapsed ecosystems. Question: The passage suggests that the main reason dinosaurs went extinct after the asteroid impact was ---.
secenekler: the immediate physical damage caused by the asteroid's crash
the sudden disappearance of water sources across the planet
the collapse of food chains due to blocked sunlight and cold
diseases that spread rapidly among weakened animal groups
a sudden increase in volcanic activity near their habitats
aciklama: Pasajda çarpışmanın atmosfere toz ve döküntü fırlatarak güneş ışığını engellediği ve ekosistemleri çökerterek küresel bir kışa yol açtığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, güneş ışığının engellenmesi ve soğuk havanın besin zincirlerini çökertmesi sonucu dinozorların yok olduğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: A stroke occurs when the blood supply to part of the brain is interrupted or reduced, depriving brain tissue of oxygen. Within minutes, brain cells begin to die, which is why immediate medical attention is critical to minimize brain damage. Question: According to the passage, quick medical intervention during a stroke is vital because ---.
secenekler: it can prevent the stroke from happening in the future
brain cells start dying very quickly without oxygen
strokes are usually painless and hard to notice
it allows doctors to perform complex brain surgeries easily
the blood supply can only be restored using advanced chemicals
aciklama: Pasajda felç sırasında beyne giden kan akışının azaldığı ve oksijensiz kalan beyin hücrelerinin dakikalar içinde ölmeye başladığı ifade edilmiştir. Bu yüzden, hücre ölümlerini ve beyin hasarını en aza indirmek için hızlı tıbbi müdahale hayati önem taşır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Detective fiction became immensely popular in the late 19th century, largely due to Arthur Conan Doyle's stories featuring Sherlock Holmes. Doyle's use of scientific observation and logical deduction influenced real-world forensic science and criminal investigation. Question: It can be inferred from the passage that Sherlock Holmes stories ---.
secenekler: were based entirely on real criminal cases in London
had an impact on how actual crimes were investigated
were criticized by police officers for being unrealistic
lost their popularity after the author stopped writing them
focused more on action scenes than logical deduction
aciklama: Pasajda Sherlock Holmes'un bilimsel gözlem ve mantıksal çıkarım yöntemlerinin gerçek dünyadaki adli tıp ve suç soruşturmalarını etkilediği belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, hikayelerin gerçek hayattaki suç araştırma yöntemleri üzerinde somut bir etki bıraktığını gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Renewable energy technologies, such as wind turbines, have become highly efficient over the past decade. Modern wind turbines are larger, lighter, and can generate electricity even in low-wind conditions, reducing reliance on fossil fuels. Question: According to the passage, modern wind turbines are better than older ones because they ---.
secenekler: are made of cheaper materials that are easy to find
can produce electricity with less wind power than before
do not require any maintenance after installation
can store electricity inside their own structures
are small enough to be placed inside crowded cities
aciklama: Pasajda modern rüzgar türbinlerinin daha büyük, hafif olduğu ve düşük rüzgar koşullarında bile elektrik üretebildiği belirtilmiştir.
