soru_metni: Paragraph: Caffeine works by blocking adenosine receptors in the brain, which are responsible for promoting sleep and relaxation. By preventing adenosine from binding to these receptors, caffeine keeps us awake and alert, temporarily reducing the feeling of fatigue. Question: According to the passage, caffeine helps people stay awake by ---.
secenekler: increasing the overall production of adenosine in the brain
stopping a sleep-promoting chemical from doing its job
permanently curing chronic fatigue and lack of focus
replacing the natural sleep hormones with synthetic stimulants
forcing the brain to produce more stress hormones like cortisol
aciklama: Pasajda kafeinin, uyku ve gevşemeyi teşvik eden adenozin reseptörlerini bloke ederek çalıştığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, kafeinin uykuyu artıran bir kimyasalın görevini yapmasını engelleyerek uyanık kalmayı sağladığını gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Great Barrier Reef is the largest coral reef system on Earth, visible even from space. However, it is under severe threat from ocean warming and pollution. If these environmental pressures continue, this massive marine ecosystem could suffer irreversible damage. Question: It is understood from the passage that the Great Barrier Reef ---.
secenekler: is so small that it can only be seen with microscopes
is currently safe from any environmental dangers or warming
faces a critical risk of permanent destruction due to human activities
has already recovered completely from all past damage
consists of artificial coral structures built by marine biologists
aciklama: Pasajda resifin okyanus ısınması ve kirlilik nedeniyle ciddi tehdit altında olduğu ve geri dönülemez zarar görebileceği belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, bu devasa deniz ekosisteminin kalıcı bir yıkım riskiyle karşı karşıya olduğunu doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Code of Hammurabi, created in ancient Babylon around 1750 BC, is one of the earliest and most complete written legal codes in history. It established standards for commercial interactions and set fines and punishments to meet the requirements of justice. Question: According to the passage, the Code of Hammurabi ---.
secenekler: was written to ban all trade activities in ancient Babylon
is a modern set of laws used by European court systems
represents an early attempt to regulate society through written laws
only focused on punishments without setting any fines
was lost in ancient times and has never been recovered
aciklama: Metinde Hammurabi Kanunları'nın tarihteki en eski ve en eksiksiz yazılı yasalarından biri olduğu ve adaleti sağlamak için cezalar ile ticari standartlar belirlediği ifade edilmiştir. Bu, toplumun yazılı yasalarla düzenlenmesine yönelik erken bir adımı temsil eder.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Quantum computing utilizes the principles of quantum mechanics to process information in ways that traditional computers cannot. While classical computers use bits (0s and 1s), quantum computers use qubits, allowing them to solve highly complex scientific calculations much faster. Question: The passage suggests that quantum computers are different from classical computers because they ---.
secenekler: rely on traditional mathematical models to analyze datasets
operate on quantum principles to achieve superior processing speed
are much easier and cheaper to manufacture for home use
use identical processing units called classical bits
are designed exclusively for playing high-end video games
aciklama: Pasajda kuantum bilgisayarlarının geleneksel bilgisayarların yapamadığı şekillerde bilgi işlemek için kuantum mekaniği ilkelerini kullandığı ve hesaplamaları çok daha hızlı çözdüğü belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, onların üstün işlem hızına ulaşmak için kuantum prensiplerine dayandığını gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Meditation has been shown to reduce the size of the amygdala, the brain region associated with fear, anxiety, and stress. Conversely, it increases the thickness of the prefrontal cortex, which is responsible for decision-making, focus, and self-awareness. Question: According to the passage, regular meditation can ---.
secenekler: enlarge the brain region that triggers stress and fear
alter the physical structure of different parts of the brain
cure all neurological disorders without medical help
reduce a person's ability to focus on complex tasks
prevent the prefrontal cortex from growing as we age
aciklama: Metinde meditasyonun korku ve stresle ilişkili amigdalayı küçülttüğü, karar verme ve odaklanmadan sorumlu prefrontal korteksi ise kalınlaştırdığı belirtilmiştir. Bu, meditasyonun beynin farklı bölümlerinin fiziksel yapısını değiştirebildiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Industrial Revolution, which began in Great Britain in the late 18th century, transformed agrarian societies into industrialized, urban ones. The introduction of steam power and machinery allowed for mass production, but it also created harsh working conditions. Question: One can understand from the passage that the Industrial Revolution ---.
secenekler: had only positive outcomes for the working-class people
was caused by a sudden decline in agricultural production
shifted the economy from agriculture to machine-based manufacturing
was limited strictly to the geographical boundaries of Great Britain
made manual labor more valuable than steam-powered machinery
aciklama: Pasajda Sanayi Devrimi'nin tarım toplumlarını sanayileşmiş ve kentsel toplumlara dönüştürdüğü, bu süreçte buhar gücü ve makinelerin seri üretime izin verdiği belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, ekonominin tarımdan makineye dayalı üretime kaydığını gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Ocean acidification occurs when the ocean absorbs excess carbon dioxide from the atmosphere, making the water more acidic. This change in chemistry prevents marine organisms, like oysters and corals, from building their protective shells and skeletons. Question: According to the passage, ocean acidification is dangerous because it ---.
secenekler: increases the temperature of surface waters too rapidly
prevents certain marine animals from forming their shells
leads to an overpopulation of corals in deep waters
removes all dissolved oxygen from the ocean environment
causes oceans to evaporate faster than they can refill
aciklama: Pasajda okyanus asitlenmesinin deniz suyunun kimyasını değiştirerek istiridye ve mercan gibi canlıların koruyucu kabuk ve iskeletlerini oluşturmalarını engellediği ifade edilmiştir. Bu yüzden, bu süreç bazı deniz canlılarının kabuk oluşturma yeteneğine doğrudan zarar verir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Vitamin D is crucial for maintaining bone health because it helps the body absorb calcium from food. While some foods contain Vitamin D, the primary source is sunlight, which triggers the synthesis of this essential nutrient in human skin. Question: The passage points out that Vitamin D ---.
secenekler: can only be obtained by consuming fresh dairy products
is synthesized by the body when the skin is exposed to the sun
stops the body from absorbing excess calcium from meals
is hazardous for people who have weak bone structures
must be taken as a synthetic supplement during summer days
aciklama: Metinde D vitamininin temel kaynağının güneş ışığı olduğu ve güneşin insan derisinde bu temel besinin sentezini tetiklediği belirtilmiştir. Dolayısıyla, bu vitamin cilt güneş ışığına maruz kaldığında vücut tarafından üretilir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Alexander the Great created one of the largest empires in ancient history, stretching from Greece to northwestern India. Through his conquests, he spread Greek culture and language across the Middle East, initiating the Hellenistic period of cultural blending. Question: It can be inferred from the passage that Alexander's conquests ---.
secenekler: were unsuccessful in reaching the eastern parts of Asia
resulted in the complete destruction of Greek literature
led to the integration of Greek culture into conquered lands
focused only on destroying local languages and traditions
lasted for several centuries before his empire collapsed
aciklama: Pasajda Büyük İskender'in fetihleri sayesinde Yunan kültürünü ve dilini Orta Doğu'ya yaydığı ve Helenistik dönemi başlattığı ifade edilmektedir. Bu durum, fetihlerin Yunan kültürünün ele geçirilen topraklara entegre olmasını sağladığını gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Graphene is a single layer of carbon atoms arranged in a hexagonal lattice. It is incredibly thin and light, yet it is about 200 times stronger than steel and conducts electricity better than copper, making it highly valuable for future technologies. Question: According to the passage, graphene is a remarkable material because ---.
secenekler: it is heavy enough to replace copper in traditional construction
it combines extreme thinness and lightness with immense strength
it was discovered by accident during copper manufacturing
it cannot conduct electricity under any physical conditions
it is much cheaper to produce than standard carbon atoms
aciklama: Pasajda grafenin inanılmaz derecede ince ve hafif olmasına rağmen çelikten yaklaşık 200 kat daha güçlü olduğu ve bakırdan daha iyi elektrik ilettiği vurgulanmıştır. Bu, malzemenin hafiflik ve incelik ile olağanüstü dayanıklılığı bir arada barındırdığını kanıtlar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Sleep apnea is a serious disorder where breathing repeatedly stops and starts during sleep. This condition deprives the brain and the rest of the body of oxygen, leading to poor sleep quality and increasing the risk of high blood pressure. Question: According to the passage, sleep apnea ---.
secenekler: causes patients to sleep too deeply without any disruption
can be cured simply by breathing oxygen during the daytime
disrupts sleep and limits oxygen supply to vital organs
is a rare condition that has no long-term health risks
only affects people who already have high blood pressure
aciklama: Pasajda uyku apnesinin uyku sırasında nefesin durup başlamasına yol açtığı, beyni ve vücudu oksijenden mahrum bırakarak uyku kalitesini düşürdüğü söylenmiştir. Bu durum, rahatsızlığın uykuyu böldüğünü ve organlara giden oksijeni kısıtladığını gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The French Revolution of 1789 was triggered by economic hardship, social inequality, and the absolute power of the monarchy. It ended the feudal system in France and introduced the Declaration of the Rights of Man, which promoted liberty and equality. Question: One can understand from the passage that the French Revolution ---.
secenekler: strengthened the absolute power of the French monarchy
was caused by a peaceful agreement between social classes
aimed to preserve the traditional feudal system in Europe
brought about social reforms and challenged the ruling class
had no significant impact on the legal rights of citizens
aciklama: Metinde ihtilalin Fransa'daki feodal sistemi sona erdirdiği ve özgürlük ile eşitliği teşvik eden İnsan Hakları Beyannamesi'ni sunduğu belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, devrimin sosyal reformlar getirdiğini ve egemen sınıfa meydan okuduğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Launched in 1990, the Hubble Space Telescope has provided some of the most detailed images of distant galaxies ever captured. Because it orbits above the Earth's atmosphere, it avoids the atmospheric distortion that plagues ground-based telescopes. Question: According to the passage, the Hubble Space Telescope is highly effective because ---.
secenekler: it is located in the most distant galaxy in the universe
it does not suffer from the visual distortion caused by Earth's air
it was designed to replace all ground-based telescopes by 1990
it uses a unique laser system to clear the atmosphere of dust
it can capture images without using any light or mirrors
aciklama: Pasajda Hubble'ın Dünya atmosferinin üzerinde yörüngede olması sayesinde, yer tabanlı teleskopları olumsuz etkileyen atmosferik bozulmalardan (distortion) kaçınabildiği belirtilmiştir. Dolayısıyla, başarısı atmosferin bozucu etkilerinden uzak olmasından kaynaklanır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Omega-3 fatty acids, commonly found in fish oil, are essential nutrients that the human body cannot produce on its own. They play a vital role in brain function and have been shown to reduce inflammation and lower the risk of heart disease. Question: The passage suggests that Omega-3 fatty acids ---.
secenekler: must be obtained from external sources like diet or supplements
are harmful to brain functions if consumed in large quantities
can be easily synthesized by the body from other fats
are only useful for reducing physical pain in the muscles
should only be consumed by people with active heart diseases
aciklama: Pasajda Omega-3'ün insan vücudu tarafından kendi başına üretilemeyen hayati besinler olduğu belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, vücut üretemediği için bu asitlerin beslenme veya takviyeler gibi dış kaynaklardan alınması gerektiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Feudalism was the dominant social system in medieval Europe, where nobility held lands from the Crown in exchange for military service. Peasants were obliged to live on their lord's land and give him labor and share of the produce in exchange for military protection. Question: According to the passage, under the feudal system, peasants ---.
secenekler: owned most of the agricultural land in medieval Europe
provided labor to lords in return for physical safety
were free to travel and sell their goods to other kingdoms
did not have to pay any taxes or shares of their crops
served as the primary military advisors to the Crown
aciklama: Pasajda köylülerin (peasants) koruma karşılığında lordun topraklarında yaşamak, ona emek (labor) ve ürününden pay vermek zorunda olduğu ifade edilmiştir. Bu, köylülerin güvenlik karşılığında iş gücü sağladığı anlamına gelir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Nanotechnology involves manipulating matter at the atomic or molecular scale to create new materials with unique properties. At this tiny scale, materials often exhibit different physical, chemical, and optical behaviors compared to their larger counterparts. Question: According to the passage, nanotechnology allows scientists to ---.
secenekler: increase the physical size of molecules to make them visible
create new materials by working with matter at an atomic level
keep materials from changing their chemical properties
replace atomic research with traditional engineering methods
prove that materials behave identically at all physical scales
aciklama: Pasajda nanoteknolojinin benzersiz özelliklere sahip yeni malzemeler yaratmak için maddeyi atomik veya moleküler düzeyde manipüle etmeyi içerdiği belirtilmiştir. Bu doğrultuda, teknoloji atom düzeyinde çalışarak yeni materyaller üretilmesini sağlar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Lactose intolerance is a digestive disorder caused by the inability to digest lactose, the main sugar in dairy products. It occurs when the small intestine does not produce enough of the enzyme lactase, which is needed to break lactose down. Question: According to the passage, lactose intolerance is caused by ---.
secenekler: an overproduction of digestive enzymes in the small intestine
a deficiency in the enzyme responsible for breaking down milk sugar
consuming too much calcium and protein from non-dairy sources
a genetic mutation that prevents the stomach from digesting any food
bacteria that attack the healthy tissues of the digestive tract
aciklama: Pasajda laktoz intoleransının, sütün içindeki temel şeker olan laktozu parçalamak için gereken laktaz enziminin ince bağırsakta yeterince üretilmemesinden kaynaklandığı söylenmiştir. Dolayısıyla bu durum, süt şekerini parçalayan enzimin eksikliğinden ileri gelir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Maya civilization was famous for its highly developed writing system, architecture, and mathematical methods. They developed an accurate calendar system based on astronomical observations, showing their deep understanding of the movements of celestial bodies. Question: It is stated in the passage that the Mayan calendar ---.
secenekler: was adopted from older European civilizations they traded with
was created without using any mathematical or scientific calculations
reflected their sophisticated knowledge of astronomy and stars
was primarily used to predict sudden natural disasters
had no connection to the movements of celestial bodies
aciklama: Metinde Mayaların astronomik gözlemlere dayalı doğru bir takvim sistemi geliştirdikleri ve bunun da gök cisimlerinin hareketlerine dair derin anlayışlarını gösterdiği belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, takvimin onların ileri astronomi bilgisini yansıttığını doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Volcanic eruptions are driven by the movement of tectonic plates beneath the Earth's crust. When these plates collide or slide past each other, magma is forced upward, leading to eruptions that can reshape landscapes and temporarily cool the global climate. Question: According to the passage, volcanic eruptions can ---.
secenekler: cause tectonic plates to stop moving permanently
lead to a temporary decrease in global temperatures
only occur in areas where there are no tectonic activities
heat the earth's atmosphere for several decades
prevent magma from reaching the surface of the Earth
aciklama: Pasajda volkanik patlamaların yeryüzünü yeniden şekillendirebileceği ve küresel iklimi geçici olarak soğutabileceği (temporarily cool) belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, patlamaların küresel sıcaklıklarda geçici bir düşüşe yol açabileceğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The discovery of penicillin by Alexander Fleming in 1928 revolutionized medicine by introducing the first effective treatment for bacterial infections. Before penicillin, minor injuries and common illnesses could easily lead to severe infections and death. Question: The passage highlights that before the discovery of penicillin, ---.
secenekler: bacterial infections were not considered a serious medical problem
doctors used synthetic chemicals that had no side effects
even small physical injuries could result in fatal infections
Alexander Fleming had already invented other strong antibiotics
viral infections were much easier to treat than they are today
aciklama: Pasajda penisilin öncesinde ufak yaralanmaların ve yaygın hastalıkların kolayca ciddi enfeksiyonlara ve ölüme yol açabildiği ifade edilmiştir. Bu yüzden, penisilin keşfinden önce küçük yaralar bile ölümcül olabilmekteydi.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Opportunity cost is an economic concept that refers to the value of the next best alternative that must be given up when making a decision. Understanding opportunity cost helps individuals and businesses make more rational choices by analyzing trade-offs. Question: According to the passage, opportunity cost is important because it ---.
secenekler: eliminates the need to make difficult financial decisions
represents the profit gained from a chosen business strategy
refers to the benefits lost by not choosing the alternative option
is a tax collected by governments during commercial trades
forces businesses to focus only on a single product line
aciklama: Metinde fırsat maliyetinin (opportunity cost), bir karar verilirken vazgeçilmesi gereken en iyi alternatifin değeri olduğu belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, kavramın seçilmeyen alternatif seçeneğin kaybedilen faydalarını ifade ettiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Aurora Borealis, or Northern Lights, is a natural light display caused by collisions between electrically charged particles from the Sun and gas molecules in the Earth's atmosphere. This interaction occurs near the polar regions, where the Earth's magnetic field is strongest. Question: The passage explains that the Aurora Borealis is created by ---.
secenekler: artificial satellites that reflect sunlight back to Earth
the friction between ocean waves and wind near the poles
solar particles interacting with gases in our atmosphere
volcanic dust that rises to the upper layers of the sky
the sudden warming of the Earth's magnetic poles
aciklama: Pasajda Kuzey Işıkları'nın, Güneş'ten gelen yüklü parçacıkların Dünya atmosferindeki gaz molekülleriyle çarpışması sonucu oluştuğu belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, ışıkların güneş parçacıkları ile atmosferik gazların etkileşimiyle oluştuğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Alzheimer's disease is a progressive neurological disorder that leads to the death of brain cells, causing memory loss and cognitive decline. While there is currently no cure, early diagnosis allows for treatments that can help manage symptoms and improve quality of life. Question: According to the passage, early diagnosis of Alzheimer's is valuable because it ---.
secenekler: completely stops the progression of the disease and repairs brain cells
allows patients to receive therapies that help control their symptoms
proves that the disease is genetic rather than environmental
eliminates the cognitive decline associated with aging
makes it possible for doctors to reverse the damage to brain tissues
aciklama: Pasajda Alzheimer'in kesin bir tedavisi olmasa da erken teşhisin belirtileri yönetmeye ve yaşam kalitesini artırmaya yardımcı olan tedavilere olanak sağladığı belirtilmiştir. Bu nedenle erken teşhis, hastaların semptomlarını kontrol etmelerine yardımcı olur.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Great Wall of China was not built all at once but was constructed over several centuries by different dynasties. Originally built to protect the empire from nomadic invasions, it also served as a border control system that regulated trade along the Silk Road. Question: It can be learned from the passage that the Great Wall of China ---.
secenekler: was fully completed within the reign of a single dynasty
had defensive purposes as well as economic regulation roles
failed to protect the Chinese empire from nomadic attacks
was built primarily as a monument to honor ancient emperors
completely blocked all trade activities along the Silk Road
aciklama: Pasajda Çin Seddi'nin imparatorluğu göçebe istilalarından korumak için inşa edildiği, aynı zamanda İpek Yolu boyunca ticareti düzenleyen bir sınır kontrol sistemi görevi gördüğü belirtilmiştir. Bu, yapının hem savunma hem de ekonomik düzenleme işlevlerine sahip olduğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Geothermal energy utilizes the heat stored beneath the Earth's surface to generate electricity and heat buildings. Because it is independent of weather conditions, unlike solar and wind power, geothermal energy provides a highly reliable source of renewable power. Question: According to the passage, geothermal energy is more reliable than solar or wind energy because it ---.
secenekler: is much cheaper to install and maintain in large cities
does not depend on the weather to generate electricity
can only be accessed in tropical regions near the equator
produces much higher amounts of carbon dioxide emissions
utilizes atmospheric heat rather than subterranean temperature
aciklama: Metinde jeotermal enerjinin güneş ve rüzgar enerjisinin aksine hava koşullarından bağımsız olduğu ve bu yüzden oldukça güvenilir bir yenilenebilir güç kaynağı sunduğu belirtilmiştir. Hava koşullarına bağlı olmaması onu daha kararlı bir enerji kaynağı yapar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: When a pathogen enters the body, the immune system produces antibodies to neutralize it. These antibodies are highly specific proteins designed to bind to a particular antigen on the virus or bacteria, preventing it from harming healthy cells. Question: According to the passage, antibodies protect the body by ---.
secenekler: destroying all cells in the body to eliminate the pathogen
binding specifically to antigens to neutralize foreign invaders
changing their chemical structure to adapt to different organs
converting harmful bacteria into useful digestive enzymes
preventing pathogens from ever entering the human body
aciklama: Pasajda antikorların virüs veya bakteriler üzerindeki belirli antijenlere bağlanarak onları etkisiz hale getiren özel proteinler olduğu söylenmiştir. Bu durum, antikorların yabancı istilacıları nötralize etmek için antijenlere özel olarak bağlandığını doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Michelangelo, one of the greatest artists of the Renaissance, was famous for his deep understanding of human anatomy. His sculptures, such as David, show an incredible level of realistic detail, capturing tension and emotion in stone. Question: The passage suggests that Michelangelo's artistic success was partly due to ---.
secenekler: his rejection of realistic details in favor of abstract concepts
his knowledge of the structure of the human body
his focus on painting historical landscapes rather than sculptures
the cheap and easy-to-carve stone materials he preferred to use
his refusal to depict emotions in his classical artworks
aciklama: Pasajda Michelangelo'nun insan anatomisine dair derin anlayışıyla ünlü olduğu ve heykellerinin inanılmaz düzeyde gerçekçi detaylar barındırdığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, onun başarısında insan vücudunun yapısını bilmesinin (anatomik bilgi) etkili olduğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Desertification is a type of land degradation where dry land regions become increasingly arid, losing their water bodies, vegetation, and wildlife. It is caused by a variety of factors, including climate change and unsustainable farming practices. Question: According to the passage, desertification is driven by ---.
secenekler: the rapid growth of wildlife populations in dry areas
both natural climate variations and human agricultural activities
sustainable irrigation methods used by modern farmers
a sudden increase in the water levels of global lakes
the migration of local populations to industrial cities
aciklama: Metinde çölleşmenin iklim değişikliği ve sürdürülemez tarım uygulamaları dahil çeşitli faktörlerden kaynaklandığı belirtilmiştir. Bu, çölleşmenin hem iklimsel (doğal) hem de insan kaynaklı tarımsal faaliyetlerden etkilendiğini kanıtlar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Obesity has become a global health crisis, closely linked to the availability of cheap, calorie-dense foods and sedentary lifestyles. Public health experts argue that combating obesity requires systemic changes, such as restricting sugar advertisements and encouraging physical education. Question: The passage suggests that addressing the obesity crisis requires ---.
secenekler: treating the condition as an individual issue rather than a social one
implementing policy changes regarding food promotion and exercise
lowering the prices of high-calorie and processed foods in markets
completely banning all sugary foods and drinks from supermarkets
forcing every adult citizen to perform daily high-intensity workouts
aciklama: Pasajda obeziteyle mücadelenin şeker reklamlarının kısıtlanması ve beden eğitiminin teşvik edilmesi gibi sistemsel değişiklikler gerektirdiği belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, gıda tanıtımı ve egzersiz konularında politika değişikliklerinin uygulanması gerektiği önerisini doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Global Positioning System (GPS) relies on a network of satellites orbiting the Earth that transmit precise time and location data. A GPS receiver on Earth uses signals from at least four satellites to calculate its exact position using trilateration. Question: According to the passage, a GPS receiver determines location by ---.
secenekler: sending signals back to satellites in orbit to measure distance
analyzing data received from multiple orbiting satellites
relying on ground-based radio towers in crowded urban areas
predicting the weather conditions that affect signal speeds
measuring the temperature of the Earth's magnetic field
aciklama: Pasajda bir GPS alıcısının, trilaterasyon yöntemini kullanarak tam konumunu hesaplamak için en az dört uydudan gelen sinyalleri kullandığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, alıcının yörüngedeki birden fazla uydudan veri alarak konum belirlediğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The ancient Olympic Games, held in Olympia, Greece, were originally part of a religious festival honoring Zeus. During the games, an Olympic truce was declared, allowing athletes and spectators to travel safely from warring city-states to participate. Question: According to the passage, the Olympic truce was significant because it ---.
secenekler: allowed the games to be played without any religious ceremonies
enabled people from conflicting regions to travel and compete safely
forced warring city-states to sign permanent peace treaties
banned athletes from participating if their cities were at war
was declared to honor the winners of the running competitions
aciklama: Pasajda olimpiyat ateşkesi (truce) ilan edildiği ve bunun sporcular ile seyircilerin savaşan şehir devletlerinden güvenli bir şekilde seyahat etmelerini sağladığı belirtilmiştir. Bu yönüyle ateşkes, çatışmalı bölgelerdeki insanların güvenle seyahat edip yarışmasına imkan tanımıştır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Deep-sea hydrothermal vents are fissures on the ocean floor that geothermally heat seawater. Despite the extreme heat, pressure, and toxic chemicals, these vents support complex ecosystems that rely on chemosynthesis rather than photosynthesis for energy. Question: It is understood from the passage that ecosystems near hydrothermal vents ---.
secenekler: are identical to the ecosystems found in shallow coastal waters
do not depend on sunlight to generate their primary energy
are highly sensitive to the cold water surrounding the fissures
cannot survive the toxic chemicals dissolved in the seawater
rely on marine plants that capture sunlight for photosynthesis
aciklama: Pasajda bu ekosistemlerin enerji için fotosentez yerine kemosenteze (chemosynthesis) dayandığı belirtilmiştir. Fotosentez güneş ışığı gerektirirken kemosentez kimyasal reaksiyonları kullanır; bu da ekosistemin güneş ışığı olmadan yaşadığını gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Consuming excessive amounts of sugar leads to rapid spikes in blood glucose, forcing the pancreas to release high levels of insulin. Over time, this constant demand can exhaust the pancreas and lead to insulin resistance, a precursor to Type 2 diabetes. Question: The passage explains that a diet high in sugar can harm the body by ---.
secenekler: preventing the pancreas from producing any insulin forever
causing insulin resistance due to the constant strain on the pancreas
reducing the glucose levels in the blood to dangerous levels
directly destroying the physical structure of the small intestine
forcing the body to rely entirely on genetic Type 1 insulin
aciklama: Metinde aşırı şeker tüketiminin pankreası yüksek düzeyde insülin salgılamaya zorladığı ve zamanla bu sürekli talebin insülin direncine yol açtığı belirtilmiştir. Dolayısıyla, yüksek şekerli beslenme pankreası yıpratarak insülin direncini tetikler.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The rapid expansion of cities into surrounding rural areas is known as urban sprawl. This phenomenon often leads to increased car dependency, longer commute times, and the destruction of agricultural lands and natural habitats. Question: According to the passage, urban sprawl results in ---.
secenekler: a decrease in the number of vehicles on urban highways
the preservation of rural and agricultural environments
environmental damage and greater reliance on personal vehicles
shorter travel times for people commuting to work
the rapid reconstruction of historic buildings in city centers
aciklama: Pasajda kentsel yayılmanın (urban sprawl) araç bağımlılığını artırdığı, ulaşım sürelerini uzattığı ve tarım arazileri ile doğal yaşam alanlarını yok ettiği ifade edilmiştir. Bu durum, çevreye zarar verdiğini ve kişisel araçlara olan bağımlılığı artırdığını doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Nuclear fusion is the process where two light atomic nuclei combine to form a heavier one, releasing vast amounts of energy. Scientists are trying to replicate this process on Earth to create a clean, virtually limitless source of power. Question: According to the passage, scientists are researching nuclear fusion to ---.
secenekler: divide heavy atoms into smaller particles to generate power
develop a clean and nearly infinite energy source
reduce the temperature of stars in distant galaxies
replace all renewable energy technologies with coal
prevent light atomic nuclei from combining naturally
aciklama: Pasajda bilim insanlarının nükleer füzyon sürecini Dünya'da kopyalayarak temiz ve neredeyse sınırsız (virtually limitless) bir güç kaynağı yaratmaya çalıştıkları belirtilmiştir. Bu nedenle, temiz ve sonsuz enerji üretmek araştırmanın temel amacıdır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Strength training, such as lifting weights, stimulates osteoblasts, which are cells that build new bone tissue. Regular resistance exercise is highly recommended for older adults to increase bone density and prevent osteoporosis. Question: The passage suggests that strength training is beneficial for older adults because it ---.
secenekler: reduces the workload of osteoblast cells in the body
helps increase bone density by stimulating bone-building cells
cures osteoporosis immediately without any dietary changes
replaces the need for any form of aerobic cardiovascular exercise
prevents bones from absorbing calcium from daily meals
aciklama: Pasajda ağırlık kaldırma gibi kuvvet antrenmanlarının yeni kemik dokusu inşa eden osteoblast hücrelerini uyardığı ve kemik yoğunluğunu artırdığı belirtilmiştir. Bu yüzden, bu egzersiz türü kemik yapıcı hücreleri uyararak kemik yoğunluğunu artırır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Industrialization has drastically increased air pollution by releasing sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides into the atmosphere. These gases react with water vapor to form acid rain, which damages forests, soils, and aquatic ecosystems. Question: According to the passage, acid rain is formed when ---.
secenekler: global temperatures drop rapidly during winter seasons
industrial gases chemically react with water in the air
clean rainwater evaporates from polluted soil surfaces
trees release excessive carbon dioxide into the atmosphere
aquatic ecosystems absorb harmful chemicals from factory wastes
aciklama: Pasajda kükürt dioksit ve azot oksit gazlarının atmosferdeki su buharıyla (water vapor) reaksiyona girerek asit yağmurunu oluşturduğu belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, asit yağmurunun sanayi gazlarının havadaki suyla kimyasal tepkimesi sonucu oluştuğunu doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Cleopatra, the last active ruler of the Ptolemaic Kingdom of Egypt, was famous for her political intelligence and charisma. Unlike her predecessors, she learned the Egyptian language, which helped her build a strong connection with her subjects. Question: It can be inferred from the passage that Cleopatra ---.
secenekler: was the first ruler of Egypt who refused to speak Greek
used her language skills to establish a bond with Egyptian people
lost her political power because she focused too much on charisma
was interested only in military conquests rather than politics
belonged to a dynasty that had always spoken Egyptian fluently
aciklama: Metinde Kleopatra'nın öncekilerin aksine Mısır dilini öğrendiği ve bunun halkıyla (subjects) güçlü bir bağ kurmasına yardımcı olduğu belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, dil becerisini halkla bağ kurmak için kullandığını gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Bioluminescence is the production of light by living organisms, such as fireflies and deep-sea fish. This light is generated through a chemical reaction involving the enzyme luciferase and is used for attracting mates or deterring predators. Question: According to the passage, bioluminescent organisms use light to ---.
secenekler: warm themselves up in extremely cold deep-sea waters
perform photosynthesis in the absence of sunlight
find mates or defend themselves against potential dangers
signal to scientists who are researching marine life
change their physical shape to hide from predators
aciklama: Pasajda biyolüminesansın eşleri çekmek (attracting mates) veya avcıları caydırmak (deterring predators) amacıyla kullanıldığı söylenmiştir. Bu durum, ışığın üreme ve savunma amaçlı kullanıldığını kanıtlar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Vitamin C is a water-soluble vitamin that acts as a powerful antioxidant, protecting cells from damage caused by free radicals. Since humans cannot synthesize Vitamin C internally, it must be consumed daily through fruits and vegetables. Question: The passage points out that human beings ---.
secenekler: can store Vitamin C in their bodies for several months
must obtain Vitamin C from their daily diet
are capable of producing Vitamin C during photosynthesis
should avoid consuming too many fresh fruits and vegetables
do not need antioxidants to protect their cells from damage
aciklama: Pasajda insanların D vitamininin aksine vücutta C vitamini sentezleyemedikleri, bu yüzden bu vitaminin günlük olarak meyve ve sebzelerden alınması gerektiği söylenmiştir. Bu sebeple C vitamini beslenme yoluyla dışarıdan alınmalıdır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Under the Gold Standard, a country's currency was directly linked to gold, meaning that paper money could be exchanged for a specific amount of physical gold. While it provided economic stability, it limited a government's ability to adjust the money supply during crises. Question: According to the passage, a major disadvantage of the Gold Standard was that it ---.
secenekler: caused rapid inflation because paper money had no real value
made it difficult for governments to manage money during recessions
prevented international trade between countries with different currencies
forced countries to replace all paper money with physical gold coins
was highly unstable and caused frequent fluctuations in prices
aciklama: Metinde Altın Standart sisteminin kriz anlarında hükümetlerin para arzını ayarlama yeteneğini sınırladığı (limited the ability to adjust money supply) belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, sistemin ekonomik kriz ve resesyonlarda para yönetimini zorlaştırdığını doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Dark matter is an invisible substance that makes up about 27% of the universe. Although it does not emit, absorb, or reflect light, scientists know it exists because of its gravitational effects on the movement of galaxies. Question: One can understand from the passage that dark matter ---.
secenekler: can be easily observed using traditional optical telescopes
has no physical mass or gravitational impact on space
makes up the entirety of the physical universe
is identified by scientists through its gravitational influence
absorbs all light that passes near its surface
aciklama: Pasajda karanlık maddenin ışığı yansıtmadığı veya yaymadığı, ancak gökadaların hareketleri üzerindeki kütleçekimsel etkilerinden (gravitational effects) dolayı varlığının bilindiği ifade edilmiştir. Bu yüzden, bilim insanları onun varlığını kütleçekimsel etkisiyle tespit eder.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Parkinson's disease is a degenerative disorder of the central nervous system that mainly affects motor functions. It occurs when dopamine-producing neurons in the brain die, leading to symptoms like tremors, stiffness, and difficulty walking. Question: According to the passage, the symptoms of Parkinson's disease ---.
secenekler: are caused by the death of cells that produce dopamine
can be easily cured by taking dopamine pills once
primarily affect cognitive memory rather than movement
are genetic and show no physical symptoms in adults
result from an overproduction of motor neurons in the brain
aciklama: Pasajda Parkinson'un beyindeki dopamin üreten nöronların ölmesiyle ortaya çıktığı ve bunun titreme, sertlik ve yürüme zorluğuna yol açtığı belirtilmiştir. Bu nedenle, semptomların nedeni bu nöronların yok olmasıdır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Aztecs built an empire in central Mexico, famous for their unique agricultural system of chinampas, or artificial floating islands. These highly productive fields allowed them to grow crops on shallow lake beds, feeding their massive population. Question: According to the passage, the Aztec agricultural system was innovative because it ---.
secenekler: relied entirely on imports from neighboring civilizations
utilized artificial islands on lakes to grow food crops
was developed to grow crops without using any water
banned the use of manual labor in farming activities
allowed them to grow crops on dry desert mountains
aciklama: Pasajda Azteklerin "chinampa" adı verilen yapay yüzen adalar kurarak sığ göl yataklarında tarım yaptıkları ifade edilmiştir. Bu yöntem, göller üzerindeki yapay adaları tarımsal üretim için kullanmaları yönüyle yenilikçidir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Synthetic biology is a multidisciplinary field that combines biology and engineering to design and construct new biological parts or redesign existing natural systems. This technology could lead to breakthroughs in medicine, biofuel production, and agriculture. Question: The passage suggests that synthetic biology ---.
secenekler: focuses only on analyzing ancient fossilized DNA samples
is a branch of traditional agriculture that rejects engineering
involves the artificial creation or modification of biological systems
has already solved all major environmental and medical crises
is limited to the study of marine plants and micro-organisms

have a well-known genetic cause that has been cured

soru_metni: Paragraph: Tectonic plates are massive slabs of rock that make up the Earth's outer crust. Their constant, slow movement is driven by heat from the core. the pressure of volcanic ash trapped under the crust
the friction created when tectonic plates move past one another
rapid changes in global weather patterns and oceans
human activities such as drilling and mining in deep fault lines
aciklama: Pasajda tektonik levhalar birbirinin yanından kayarken oluşan sürtünmenin fay hatları boyunca depremlere yol açtığı ifade edilmiştir. Bu sebeple depremlerin temel nedeni, levha hareketlerinden kaynaklanan bu sürtünmedir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Sumerian cuneiform, developed in ancient Mesopotamia around 3200 BC, is considered one of the earliest writing systems. was initially created for business and trade record-keeping
is still used today in some remote parts of Mesopotamia
was too complex to be used for recording laws and literature
was adopted from older writing systems used in ancient Europe

soru_metni: Paragraph: Solar winds are streams of charged particles released from the upper atmosphere of the Sun. Question: According to the passage, solar winds can ---.

cause damage to human technology and communication systems
be completely blocked by the moon before reaching Earth
lower the temperatures of oceans during winter seasons
generate unlimited clean electricity for cities on Earth
aciklama: Pasajda güneş rüzgarlarının uydu iletişimini ve elektrik şebekelerini bozabilecek manyetik fırtınalara yol açtığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, rüzgarların insan yapımı teknolojilere ve iletişim sistemlerine zarar verebileceğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Chronic insomnia is a sleep disorder characterized by difficulty falling or staying asleep, even when there is plenty of time to do so. sleep for longer hours only during the weekend days

exercise intensely right before going to bed at night

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Great Depression, which began in 1929, was the worst economic downturn in industrialized history. started in Europe and then spread rapidly to the United States
resulted in high employment rates across industrialized countries
was initiated by a collapse in the American stock market

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Gulf Stream is a warm, swift ocean current that originates in the Gulf of Mexico and flows into the Atlantic. was created artificially to improve sea trade in the Atlantic

soru_metni: Paragraph: Antibiotics are powerful medications designed to kill or inhibit the growth of harmful bacteria. are the primary treatment option for flu and common cold
should not be used to treat infections caused by viruses

soru_metni: Paragraph: Ancient Greek democracy, developed in Athens around the 5th century BC, allowed citizens to vote directly on laws. was a representative system rather than a direct voting democracy

was abandoned quickly due to constant invasions from Persia

soru_metni: Paragraph: Hydrogen fuel cells generate clean electricity by combining hydrogen and oxygen, producing only water vapor as a byproduct. soru_metni: Paragraph: Hypertension, or high blood pressure, is often called a "silent killer" because it rarely shows noticeable symptoms. soru_metni: Paragraph: A population census is an official count of a country's population, usually conducted every ten years. gather data for planning public infrastructure and funding
prevent citizens from migrating to foreign countries

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Asteroid Belt, located between the orbits of Mars and Jupiter, contains millions of rocky bodies. rocky bodies are widely dispersed rather than tightly packed
planets are formed regularly due to frequent asteroid crashes
there are no rocky bodies larger than a few meters in diameter
space travel is impossible because of the density of rocks

soru_metni: Paragraph: The circadian rhythm is the body's internal 24-hour clock, which regulates the sleep-wake cycle. soru_metni: Paragraph: Julius Caesar reformed the Roman calendar in 46 BC, introducing the Julian calendar. the traditional calendar was not aligned with the Earth's orbit
the year was previously divided into ten months instead of twelve

merchants demanded a calendar that changed every six months

soru_metni: Paragraph: Carbon dating is a scientific method used to determine the age of organic materials up to 50,000 years old. using laser technology to look inside ancient stone monuments
measuring the amount of oxygen absorbed by a dead plant
aciklama: Pasajda karbon tarihleme yönteminin, radyoaktif karbon-14 izotopunun bozunmasını (decay) ölçerek çalıştığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, yöntemin belirli bir karbon izotopunun bozunma hızını analiz etmeye dayandığını doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Chronic fatigue syndrome is a complex, debilitating disorder characterized by extreme fatigue that cannot be explained by any underlying medical condition. causes extreme tiredness that is not relieved by resting
is directly linked to a well-known genetic bone disease

soru_metni: Paragraph: Chivalry was the traditional code of conduct associated with medieval knights. was created to prevent knights from serving regional lords

was ignored by most medieval knights in Western Europe
aciklama: Pasajda şövalyelik kurallarının (chivalry) savaşta cesaretin yanı sıra zayıfları koruma, sadakat ve nezaket gibi davranışları da gerektirdiği belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, kodun savaş yeteneği ile ahlaki görevleri birleştirdiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Glaciers are massive rivers of ice that move slowly under their own weight. is driven primarily by the cooling of global ocean currents

has no measurable impact on coastal ecosystems and cities
occurs only during the warmest months of the summer season
aciklama: Pasajda buzulların hızla eridiği ve bu durumun küresel deniz seviyelerinin yükselmesine önemli ölçüde katkıda bulunduğu belirtilmiştir. Bu yüzden erime, doğrudan deniz seviyelerinin yükselmesini etkiler.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The spleen is an organ that plays a vital role in filtering blood. Question: According to the passage, the spleen functions as ---.

an organ that filters blood and supports the immune system
the primary organ responsible for digesting fatty meals
a storage unit for excess oxygen and carbon dioxide gases
a gland that regulates the hormone levels in blood vessels

soru_metni: Paragraph: Cognitive dissonance is the mental discomfort felt by a person who holds two conflicting beliefs or values. Question: The passage suggests that when experiencing cognitive dissonance, people tend to ---.
secenekler: quickly change their beliefs to accept any new scientific evidence
justify their actions or ignore contradictory information
suffer from long-term neurological disorders and memory loss
seek help from professional psychologists to change their habits
completely avoid making any decisions in their daily lives
aciklama: Pasajda insanların bu zihinsel rahatsızlığı azaltmak için davranışlarını rasyonalize ettikleri veya mevcut görüşleriyle çelişen yeni bilgileri görmezden geldikleri söylenmiştir. Bu, çelişkili bilgileri yok sayma veya eylemleri haklı çıkarma eğiliminde olduklarını gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Augmented reality (AR) overlays digital information onto the real-world environment, unlike virtual reality, which creates an entirely artificial world. secenekler: replaces the physical world entirely with a digital simulation
integrates digital data into the user's real physical surroundings
is an outdated technology that is no longer used in medicine
was developed exclusively for high-end military simulation purposes
is much harder to design and use than virtual reality systems
aciklama: Pasajda artırılmış gerçekliğin (AR) sanal gerçekliğin aksine dijital bilgiyi gerçek dünya ortamının üzerine yerleştirdiği belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, teknolojinin dijital verileri gerçek fiziksel çevreye entegre ettiğini doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The introduction of anesthesia in the 1840s revolutionized surgery. Before its development, patients had to undergo painful procedures while fully conscious, limiting surgeons to fast, simple operations to minimize the patient's trauma. Question: The passage highlights that before the development of anesthesia, ---.
secenekler: surgical operations had to be performed as quickly as possible
patients were given chemical painkillers that caused memory loss
surgeons refused to perform any operations on conscious patients
physical trauma was completely avoided by using herbal oils
medical teams used virtual reality to distract their patients
aciklama: Pasajda anestezi öncesinde hastaların tamamen bilinçli ve acı içinde ameliyat edildiği, bu yüzden cerrahların travmayı azaltmak için hızlı ve basit operasyonlar yapmak zorunda kaldığı belirtilmiştir. Dolayısıyla, operasyonların olabildiğince hızlı yapılması gerekmekteydi.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Queen Elizabeth I ruled England during a period of great cultural and economic growth in the 16th century. Her reign, known as the Elizabethan Era, saw the flourishing of English drama, led by playwrights like William Shakespeare. Question: It is stated in the passage that the Elizabethan Era ---.
secenekler: was a time of economic decline and frequent civil wars in England
was famous for significant cultural achievements and drama
saw William Shakespeare ruling the country alongside the Queen
was initiated to block the spread of theatrical plays in Europe
focused entirely on expanding England's military borders to the East
aciklama: Pasajda Kraliçe I. Elizabeth'in saltanatının (Elizabeth Dönemi) kültürel ve ekonomik büyüme dönemi olduğu, William Shakespeare gibi yazarlarla İngiliz tiyatrosunun canlandığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, dönemin kültürel başarılar ve tiyatroyla ünlü olduğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Exoplanets are planets that orbit stars outside our solar system. The discovery of thousands of exoplanets over the last two decades has revolutionized astronomy, raising the possibility of finding habitable worlds elsewhere in the galaxy. Question: According to the passage, the study of exoplanets has ---.
secenekler: proven that there is no other habitable planet in our galaxy
changed our understanding of the universe by finding planets outside our solar system
depended entirely on manned spacecraft traveling to distant stars
been abandoned by astronomers due to high technological costs
focused only on finding frozen planets that do not orbit any stars
aciklama: Pasajda güneş sistemimizin dışındaki yıldızların yörüngesinde dönen binlerce ötegezegenin (exoplanets) keşfinin astronomide devrim yarattığı söylenmiştir. Bu durum, bu çalışmaların evren anlayışımızı güneş sistemi dışındaki gezegenleri bularak değiştirdiğini doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Multiple Sclerosis (MS) is a chronic disease where the immune system mistakenly attacks the protective myelin sheath covering nerve fibers. This damage disrupts communication between the brain and the rest of the body, causing various neurological symptoms. Question: According to the passage, Multiple Sclerosis occurs when ---.
secenekler: nerve fibers stop communicating with the immune system permanently
the body's defense system damages the protective layer of nerve fibers
brain cells fail to receive enough blood supply during exercise
a patient consumes foods that lack essential water-soluble vitamins
genetic mutations prevent the brain from developing during childhood
aciklama: Pasajda MS hastalığının, bağışıklık sisteminin (immune system) yanlışlıkla sinir liflerini kaplayan koruyucu miyelin kılıfına saldırmasıyla oluştuğu belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, vücut savunma sisteminin sinir koruyucu tabakasına zarar vermesiyle hastalığın ortaya çıktığını doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Incas built a vast empire in the Andes Mountains of South America, famous for their advanced terrace farming. By carving flat steps into steep mountain slopes, they created productive agricultural land and prevented soil erosion. Question: According to the passage, the Incas developed terrace farming to ---.
secenekler: transport agricultural products faster across the Andes Mountains
grow crops on steep slopes while protecting the soil from erosion
hide their food supplies from potential nomadic invaders
replace the need for irrigation systems in dry mountain regions
build massive stone cities on flat surfaces near rivers
aciklama: Pasajda İnkaların dik dağ yamaçlarına düz basamaklar (terraces) oyarak verimli tarım alanları yarattıkları ve toprak erozyonunu önledikleri belirtilmiştir. Bu, yamaçlarda tarım yapmayı sağlarken toprağı da korumayı amaçlayan bir yöntemdir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: CRISPR is a revolutionary gene-editing technology that allows scientists to make precise changes to DNA. By targeting and modifying specific genetic sequences, CRISPR has the potential to cure genetic diseases and create resilient crops. Question: The passage suggests that CRISPR technology can ---.
secenekler: completely alter the DNA of all living organisms automatically
be used to make highly accurate modifications to genetic structures
only be applied to agricultural plants to increase their size
prevent viruses from mutating and becoming immune to drugs
change the physical traits of animals without affecting their DNA
aciklama: Pasajda CRISPR'ın bilim insanlarının DNA üzerinde kesin ve hassas (precise) değişiklikler yapmasını sağlayan bir gen düzenleme teknolojisi olduğu belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, genetik yapılarda son derece hassas değişiklikler yapma yeteneğini doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Allergies occur when the immune system overreacts to a harmless substance, known as an allergen. In response, the body releases histamine, a chemical that triggers common symptoms like sneezing, itching, and watery eyes. Question: According to the passage, allergy symptoms are caused by ---.
secenekler: the direct destruction of healthy tissues by harmful allergens
the release of a chemical named histamine during an immune overreaction
a lack of white blood cells in the patient's lymphatic system
bacteria that enter the body through polluted water sources
sudden drop in blood glucose levels during spring seasons
aciklama: Pasajda alerjilerin bağışıklık sisteminin aşırı tepki vermesiyle oluştuğu, vücudun bu süreçte salgıladığı histamin adlı kimyasalın da semptomları tetiklediği söylenmiştir. Bu doğrultuda, belirtilerin nedeni histamin salgılanmasıdır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The development of suburbs in the mid-20th century was driven by the availability of affordable automobiles and new highways. This shift allowed families to live in quieter residential areas while commuting to work in city centers. Question: According to the passage, suburban growth was facilitated by ---.
secenekler: the high cost of housing in rural areas far from cities
the rise of personal transportation options and road networks
a decline in the number of jobs available in major city centers
governments forcing families to relocate to quieter areas
the destruction of historic buildings in metropolitan centers
aciklama: Pasajda banliyölerin (suburbs) gelişiminin bütçeye uygun otomobiller ve yeni otoyolların (highways) varlığı sayesinde hızlandığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, büyümenin kişisel ulaşım olanakları ve yol ağlarındaki artışla kolaylaştığını gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Biofuels are renewable fuels produced from organic materials, such as plants and agricultural waste. Unlike fossil fuels, they absorb carbon dioxide during their growth, making them a potentially carbon-neutral alternative for transportation. Question: The passage suggests that biofuels are environmentally friendly because they ---.
secenekler: do not release any carbon dioxide when burned in engines
are produced from materials that absorb carbon during growth
are much cheaper to manufacture than traditional gasoline
can be used in all electric vehicles without any batteries
eliminate the need for any form of agricultural waste management
aciklama: Pasajda biyoyakıtların bitkisel ve tarımsal atıklardan üretildiği ve bu bitkilerin büyüme aşamasında karbondioksit emdiği, bunun da yakıtı karbon-nötr kıldığı belirtilmiştir. Bu sebeple, bitkilerin karbon emmesi çevresel avantajın temel kaynağıdır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Periodontitis, commonly known as gum disease, is a serious infection that damages the soft tissue around teeth. If left untreated, it can destroy the bone that supports the teeth, leading to loose teeth or tooth loss. Question: According to the passage, untreated gum disease can ---.
secenekler: cause severe demineralization of the stomach lining
lead to the destruction of the bone structure supporting teeth
be cured easily by consuming high-sugar dairy products
prevent mouth bacteria from producing any digestive acids
only affect patients who have chronic genetic diabetes
aciklama: Pasajda tedavi edilmeyen diş eti hastalığının (periodontitis) dişleri destekleyen kemik dokusunu yok edebileceği ve diş kaybına yol açabileceği söylenmiştir. Bu durum, hastalığın dişi tutan kemik yapısına zarar verebileceğini kanıtlar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The University of Al-Qarawiyyin, founded in Morocco in 859 AD, is recognized by UNESCO as the oldest continually operating university in the world. It served as an influential academic bridge between the Islamic world and Europe. Question: According to the passage, the University of Al-Qarawiyyin is significant because it ---.

is the oldest university in the world that has never stopped operating
focused exclusively on teaching European languages and drama
was designed using modern architectural styles from East Asia
refused to allow foreign students to study classical literature

soru_metni: Paragraph: The ozone layer in the Earth's stratosphere absorbs the majority of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation. The use of synthetic chemicals like CFCs damaged this protective shield, leading to international bans that have helped the layer slowly recover. Question: According to the passage, the ozone layer is vital because it ---.
secenekler: traps warmth to prevent global winters across the earth
blocks most of the dangerous ultraviolet rays from the Sun
is the primary source of oxygen for the upper atmosphere
prevents tectonic plates from moving too rapidly under oceans
absorbs greenhouse gases released by industrial factories
aciklama: Pasajda ozon tabakasının Güneş'ten gelen zararlı ultraviyole radyasyonunun büyük kısmını emdiği belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, tabakanın zararlı ışınları engelleyerek yaşamı koruduğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: An adrenaline rush is a physiological response triggered by the release of adrenaline from the adrenal glands during high-stress situations. It increases heart rate, dilates airways, and boosts energy, preparing the body to face immediate danger. Question: According to the passage, an adrenaline rush serves to ---.
secenekler: reduce the overall metabolic energy of the body during sleep
prepare the physical body to respond to sudden threats
stop the heart from beating too fast in relaxing situations
cure chronic immune disorders without medical treatments
prevent the sensory organs from feeling physical pain or heat
aciklama: Pasajda adrenalin salgılanmasının kalp atışını hızlandırarak ve enerjiyi artırarak vücudu ani tehlikelerle yüzleşmeye hazırladığı ifade edilmiştir. Bu yüzden bu tepki, vücudu tehditlere karşı hazır hale getirme amacı taşır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Emotional intelligence refers to the ability to identify, understand, and manage one's own emotions, as well as the emotions of others. High emotional intelligence is closely linked to strong leadership skills and effective conflict resolution. Question: According to the passage, emotional intelligence is valuable because it ---.
secenekler: prevents people from feeling any negative emotions or stress
supports successful leadership and the management of conflicts
is a genetic trait that cannot be changed or improved by education
allows individuals to hide their true feelings from their families
replaces the need for logical or scientific intelligence in business
aciklama: Pasajda yüksek duygusal zekanın güçlü liderlik becerileri ve etkili çatışma çözümüyle yakından bağlantılı olduğu söylenmiştir. Bu durum, bu becerinin liderlik ve çatışmaları yönetme süreçlerine önemli bir katkı sağladığını doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Europa, one of Jupiter's moons, is of great interest to astrobiologists because its frozen crust is believed to cover a massive liquid water ocean. its atmosphere is rich in oxygen and nitrogen gases like Earth

soru_metni: Paragraph: Dietary fiber, found in plant-based foods, is a carbohydrate that the human body cannot fully digest. soru_metni: Paragraph: The law of supply and demand determines the prices of goods in a market economy. the demand for the product exceeds its available market supply
the government imposes strict tax regulations on commercial trades
alternative products become cheaper and easier for consumers to find

soru_metni: Paragraph: Wi-Fi technology transmits data using radio waves, allowing electronic devices to connect to the internet without physical cables. can be reduced by physical obstacles and electronic interference
depends entirely on the distance between the device and the moon
is guaranteed to be identical across all electronic devices

soru_metni: Paragraph: Gluten sensitivity is a condition where consuming gluten, a protein found in wheat, barley, and rye, causes adverse reactions like bloating and fatigue. is a temporary allergy that only affects children under ten
can be easily cured by consuming wheat and barley regularly
is much more dangerous and fatal than celiac disease

soru_metni: Paragraph: Roman aqueducts were magnificent engineering structures built to transport fresh water from distant springs into cities. transported water using gravity and carefully designed slopes
were built primarily to drain sewage water away from homes
could only carry water over very short physical distances
were constructed using expensive metal tubes imported from Asia
aciklama: Pasajda su kemerlerinin suyu taşımak için tamamen yerçekimine (gravity) ve hafif eğimli taş kanallara (gently sloping) dayandığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, suyun yerçekimi ve eğim tasarımıyla taşındığını doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Milky Way is a barred spiral galaxy that contains over 100 billion stars, including our Sun. our solar system is positioned within one of its spiral arms
the galaxy is much smaller than other nearby galaxies
all the stars in the galaxy emit a unique ultraviolet light
modern telescopes reflect the light back into our atmosphere

soru_metni: Paragraph: Severe sleep deprivation can significantly weaken the human immune system. it reduces the creation of proteins needed to combat illnesses
it increases the speed of oxygen absorption in blood
it leads to the permanent loss of white blood cells
it forces the body to rely entirely on external vaccines

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Industrial Revolution marked a major turning point in history, as machine power replaced manual labor. was abandoned quickly due to high machinery maintenance costs
aciklama: Metinde Sanayi Devrimi'nin üretimi artırıp fiyatları düşürdüğü (ekonomik fayda), ancak insanları kalabalık şehirlere göçe zorlayıp konut krizlerine yol açtığı (sosyal sorun) belirtilmiştir. Dolayısıyla, bu süreç hem olumlu ekonomik hem de olumsuz sosyal sonuçlar doğurmuştur.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Hydrothermal vents on the ocean floor are some of the most extreme environments on Earth, with toxic chemicals and temperatures reaching 400°C. depends on marine plants that perform photosynthesis
relies on chemical reactions rather than solar energy
consists of species that migrated from shallow lakes
is highly sensitive to the cold currents of the Pacific

soru_metni: Paragraph: Renewable energy sources like wind and solar power are clean, but they are not always reliable because they depend on the weather. To ensure a steady supply of electricity, governments must invest in advanced energy storage systems, such as large-scale batteries. Question: According to the passage, the main challenge of renewable energy is ---.

its inability to generate electricity in warm tropical climates
its dependency on weather conditions for consistent power
that it is far more expensive to maintain than nuclear power
the lack of government interest in investing in new turbines

soru_metni: Paragraph: Regular physical exercise is not only good for the body but also for mental health. Exercise stimulates the production of dopamine and serotonin, neurotransmitters that play a key role in regulating mood, reducing anxiety, and improving sleep. Question: The passage suggests that physical exercise can improve mental health by ---.
secenekler: reducing the brain's reliance on chemical neurotransmitters
triggering the release of chemicals that enhance mood
preventing the body from feeling any physical pain during stress
curing chronic anxiety disorders permanently within a few days
replacing the need for healthy eating habits in adults
aciklama: Pasajda egzersizin ruh halini düzenleyen, kaygıyı azaltan dopamin ve serotonin gibi nörotransmitterlerin üretimini uyardığı belirtilmiştir. Bu yüzden spor yapmak, zihinsel sağlığı olumlu etkileyen kimyasalların salgılanmasını sağlar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Ancient Mesopotamia, often called the cradle of civilization, succeeded because of its position between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers. By developing advanced irrigation systems, the Sumerians controlled the unpredictable flooding, allowing agriculture to flourish. Question: According to the passage, Sumerian agriculture was successful because ---.
secenekler: they imported high-quality seeds from neighboring empires
the local climate was consistently rainy throughout the year

the soils in Mesopotamia did not require any water to produce crops
aciklama: Pasajda Sümerlerin nehirlerin öngörülemeyen taşkınlarını kontrol etmek için gelişmiş sulama sistemleri kurdukları ve bu sayede tarımı geliştirdikleri belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, tarımın başarısının su yönetimi tekniklerine dayandığını gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Hundreds of thousands of pieces of space debris, often called "space junk," orbit the Earth at high speeds.
