Question: According to the passage, the Peace of Westphalia was significant because it ---.
secenekler: abolished all monarchies in Europe and established republics
introduced the concept of state sovereignty to international politics
forced all European countries to adopt a single global religion
was written to protect the trade rights of the Roman Empire
prevented European nations from building their own military forces
aciklama: Pasajda Westphalia Antlaşması'nın devlet egemenliği (state sovereignty) ilkesini getirdiği ve modern uluslararası siyasi sistemin temelini attığı söylenmiştir. Dolayısıyla antlaşma, egemenlik kavramını siyasete kazandırması açısından önemlidir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Genetically modified (GM) crops are plants whose DNA has been altered through genetic engineering. While supporters argue that GM crops can resist pests and increase food supply, critics raise concerns about their long-term impact on human health and local ecosystems. Question: One can understand from the passage that genetically modified crops ---.
secenekler: have been proven to be 100% safe for human health and soil
present potential agricultural benefits as well as ecological concerns
are much more expensive to plant than traditional organic crops
cannot perform photosynthesis without artificial light sources
were first developed to replace the need for water-soluble fertilizers
aciklama: Pasajda GDO'lu ürünlerin zararlılara dayanıklılık ve gıda arzını artırma gibi faydaları olduğu, ancak sağlık ve ekosistem üzerinde uzun vadeli etkilerine dair kaygılar bulunduğu söylenmiştir. Bu durum, teknolojinin hem fayda hem de çeşitli riskler sunduğunu doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS) is a common gastrointestinal disorder characterized by cramping, abdominal pain, bloating, and gas. Unlike inflammatory bowel diseases, IBS is a functional disorder, meaning it does not cause permanent damage or physical changes to the intestinal tissue. Question: The passage suggests that Irritable Bowel Syndrome ---.
secenekler: is a dangerous condition that requires surgical removal of tissue
affects digestion without causing structural damage to the intestine
can be easily cured by consuming high-sugar dairy products daily
is caused exclusively by a genetic mutation in the pancreas cells
only occurs in patients who have chronic immune deficiencies
aciklama: Pasajda IBS'nin fonksiyonel bir rahatsızlık olduğu, bağırsak dokusunda kalıcı hasara veya fiziksel değişime yol açmadığı (does not cause permanent damage) belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, hastalığın doku hasarı vermeden sindirimi etkilediğini doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The House of Wisdom, established in Baghdad during the Islamic Golden Age, was a major intellectual center. Scholars here gathered to translate classical Greek, Persian, and Indian scientific texts into Arabic, preserving valuable knowledge that influenced the European Renaissance. Question: According to the passage, the House of Wisdom played a key role in ---.
secenekler: preventing the spread of Greek philosophy in the Islamic world
preserving and translating ancient scientific knowledge for future eras
designing new military weapons for the defense of Baghdad
replacing traditional paper-making technologies with digital printing
banning European scholars from studying classical literature in Asia
aciklama: Metinde Beytü'l-Hikme'nin (House of Wisdom) Antik Yunan, Fars ve Hint bilimsel metinlerini Arapçaya çevirerek koruduğu ve Rönesans'ı etkilediği ifade edilmiştir. Bu durum, merkezin eski bilimsel bilgileri koruma ve aktarmadaki rolünü gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Bioremediation is an eco-friendly technology that utilizes microorganisms, such as bacteria and fungi, to clean up polluted environments. These organisms feed on toxic contaminants, like oil spills or heavy metals, converting them into harmless organic substances. Question: According to the passage, bioremediation works by ---.
secenekler: using advanced lasers to burn toxic chemicals in deep ocean waters
employing microbes to break down environmental pollutants into safe compounds
replacing polluted soils with clean soil imported from other regions
preventing bacteria from multiplying in polluted industrial zones
heating contaminated water sources to destroy chemical molecules
aciklama: Pasajda biyoremediasyonun, bakteri ve mantar gibi mikroorganizmaları kullanarak kirleticileri zararsız maddelere dönüştürme süreci olduğu söylenmiştir. Bu durum, yöntemin kirleticileri temizlemek için mikroorganizmalardan yararlandığını doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Anorexia nervosa is a serious eating disorder characterized by an intense fear of gaining weight and a distorted body image. Individuals with anorexia often restrict their food intake severely, leading to extreme weight loss and potentially life-threatening physical complications. Question: According to the passage, anorexia nervosa ---.
secenekler: is a temporary stomach infection that goes away with proper diet
causes patients to limit food consumption due to weight gain fears
primarily affects the digestive enzymes produced by the liver
can be easily cured by encouraging the patient to eat more sugar
does not cause any serious physical complications in adult patients
aciklama: Pasajda anoreksiyanın kilo alma korkusuyla karakterize olduğu ve hastaların yiyecek alımını ciddi şekilde kısıtladığı (restrict food intake severely) belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, rahatsızlığın temelinde aşırı kilo alma korkusu ve açlık diyeti olduğunu doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Fiat money is a government-issued currency that is not backed by a physical commodity like gold or silver. Instead, its value is derived from the public's trust in the issuing government and its stability in the global financial market. Question: According to the passage, the value of fiat money depends on ---.
secenekler: the total amount of physical gold stored in the central bank
public trust and the stability of the national government
the cost of printing paper bills and manufacturing coins
the geographic size and population density of the country
tax regulations imposed on international commercial trades
aciklama: Pasajda fiat paranın altın gibi fiziksel bir maddeye dayanmadığı, değerini halkın hükümete olan güveninden (public's trust) ve istikrardan aldığı belirtilmiştir. Dolayısıyla para biriminin değeri, güven ve devlet kararlılığına bağlıdır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Keystone species are organisms that play a crucial role in maintaining the structure of an ecological community. The removal of a keystone species, such as sea otters in kelp forests, can cause a dramatic collapse of the entire ecosystem. Question: It is stated in the passage that the disappearance of a keystone species ---.
secenekler: has little to no impact on the survival of other local species
can lead to the severe disruption and collapse of its habitat
helps other predatory animals multiply faster in the community
is a natural process that increases the biodiversity of oceans
only affects plants that perform photosynthesis on the seafloor
aciklama: Pasajda kilit taş türlerin (keystone species) yok olmasının tüm ekosistemin çökmesine (collapse of the entire ecosystem) yol açabileceği belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, bu türlerin yokluğunun ekolojik çevreye büyük zarar verebileceğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The lymphatic system is a critical part of the human immune system, consisting of a network of vessels and nodes. It transports lymph, a fluid containing white blood cells, throughout the body to filter out waste, bacteria, and other harmful pathogens. Question: According to the passage, the lymphatic system helps the body by ---.
secenekler: pumping blood to vital tissues when the heart rate decreases
transporting immune cells and filtering out dangerous pathogens
producing digestive enzymes for the breakdown of proteins
regulating the metabolic rate through the release of cortisol
absorbing oxygen directly from the lungs into the bloodstream
aciklama: Metinde lenfatik sistemin akyuvar içeren sıvıyı (lymph) taşıyarak atıkları, bakterileri ve zararlı patojenleri süzdüğü belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, sistemin bağışıklık hücrelerini taşıyarak zararlı maddeleri süzme görevi üstlendiğini doğrular. Setimiz (Soru 201 - 250) başarıyla tamamlandı. soru_metni: Paragraph: During deep sleep, the brain consolidates memories, transferring information from the temporary storage of the hippocampus to the long-term storage of the prefrontal cortex. This process is crucial for retaining new vocabulary and academic concepts learned during the day. Question: According to the passage, memory consolidation during deep sleep ---.
secenekler: deletes unused memories to make room for new vocabulary
moves information from temporary to long-term brain storage
occurs only when a person studies right before going to bed
is a process that scientists have been unable to prove physically
prevents the prefrontal cortex from growing as we age
aciklama: Pasajda derin uyku sırasında beynin anıları konsolide ettiği, bilgiyi hipokampüsteki geçici depolama alanından prefrontal korteksteki uzun vadeli depolama alanına aktardığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, anıların geçici alandan uzun vadeli alana taşındığını doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Roman roads were vital for the expansion and maintenance of the Roman Empire. Built with layers of stone and concrete, these durable highways allowed military legions to move quickly across provinces and facilitated trade throughout Europe and the Mediterranean. Question: It is understood from the passage that Roman roads ---.
secenekler: were built primarily using weak timber materials to save money
served both military and commercial purposes for the empire
were designed exclusively to transport luxury goods from Asia
failed to survive due to severe weather conditions in Europe
prevented the Roman army from expanding its geographic borders
aciklama: Pasajda Roma yollarının askeri lejyonların hızlı hareket etmesini sağladığı (askeri amaç) ve ticaretin yapılmasını kolaylaştırdığı (ticari amaç) belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, yolların hem askeri hem de ticari amaçlara hizmet ettiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Space radiation is one of the greatest health hazards for astronauts on long-duration missions. Unlike Earth, which is shielded by its magnetic field, deep space is filled with high-energy cosmic rays that can damage DNA and increase the risk of cancer. Question: The passage suggests that deep space travel is dangerous because ---.
secenekler: the lack of gravity prevents astronauts from digesting food properly
cosmic rays in deep space can cause genetic damage to cells
Earth's magnetic field attracts harmful radiation toward spacecraft
solar winds make it impossible for communication systems to function
the temperatures in interstellar space are too high for human survival
aciklama: Pasajda derin uzayın DNA'ya zarar verebilecek ve kanser riskini artırabilecek yüksek enerjili kozmik ışınlarla dolu olduğu ifade edilmiştir. DNA'ya zarar vermek hücresel düzeyde genetik hasara yol açtığı anlamına gelir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Photosynthesis occurs inside chloroplasts, specialized plant organelles that contain the green pigment chlorophyll. Chlorophyll absorbs sunlight and uses its energy to convert water and carbon dioxide into glucose, which provides energy for the plant. Question: According to the passage, the role of chlorophyll is to ---.
secenekler: release carbon dioxide from the leaves into the atmosphere
capture solar energy to help produce glucose for the plant
prevent plants from absorbing too much water from the soil
digest organic waste particles present on the surface of leaves
convert oxygen into light energy inside specialized plant cells
aciklama: Metinde klorofilin güneş ışığını emdiği (güneş enerjisini yakaladığı) ve bu enerjiyi su ile karbondioksiti glikoza dönüştürmek için kullandığı belirtilmiştir. Bu yüzden klorofil, bitki için glikoz üretiminde güneş enerjisini yakalama rolü üstlenir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Inflation is an economic phenomenon characterized by a general increase in prices, which reduces the purchasing power of money. When inflation is high, every unit of currency buys a smaller percentage of a good or service, harming consumers with fixed incomes. Question: According to the passage, inflation affects consumers by ---.
secenekler: increasing the overall purchasing power of their paper money
reducing the amount of goods they can buy with the same currency
forcing governments to lower tax rates on luxury products
encouraging businesses to decrease the prices of essential services
preventing banks from adjusting interest rates during financial crises
aciklama: Pasajda enflasyonun fiyatları artırarak paranın satın alma gücünü düşürdüğü belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, tüketicilerin aynı parayla daha az mal veya hizmet alabildiği (satın alma gücünün azaldığı) anlamına gelir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Marie Curie was a pioneer in the study of radioactivity, becoming the first person to win two Nobel Prizes in different scientific fields. Her discovery of the elements polonium and radium revolutionized physics and opened new pathways for cancer therapy. Question: According to the passage, Marie Curie's scientific work ---.
secenekler: was focused entirely on agricultural chemistry and botany
led to the discovery of radioactive elements used in medicine
was ignored by physicists until after her death in France
proved that radioactivity has no impact on human cell tissues
was limited strictly to the theoretical aspects of nuclear physics
aciklama: Pasajda Marie Curie'nin polonyum ve radyum elementlerini keşfettiği ve bu keşiflerin kanser tedavisinde (tıp alanında) yeni yollar açtığı ifade edilmiştir. Bu, onun tıp uygulamalarında kullanılan radyoaktif elementlerin keşfine öncülük ettiğini doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Ring of Fire is a path along the Pacific Ocean characterized by active volcanoes and frequent earthquakes. This region contains about 75% of the world's active volcanoes, driven by the constant movement and collision of tectonic plates under the sea. Question: One can understand from the passage that the Ring of Fire ---.
secenekler: is a quiet geographic area with no tectonic activity
contains the vast majority of the Earth's active volcanoes
was formed artificially by human mining and drilling activities
is located far from the tectonic boundaries of the Pacific Ocean
experiences earthquakes only during specific seasons of the year
aciklama: Pasajda Ateş Çemberi'nin dünyadaki aktif yanardağların yaklaşık %75'ini (büyük çoğunluğunu) barındırdığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, seçenekteki bilgiyi doğrudan doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Petra, an ancient city in Jordan, is famous for its rock-cut architecture and water conduit system. Established in the 4th century BC as the capital of the Nabataean Kingdom, its unique red sandstone structures were carved directly into canyon walls. Question: According to the passage, Petra is renowned for its ---.
secenekler: modern concrete high-rise buildings constructed recently
structures carved directly into natural red sandstone rocks
agricultural terrace system that relies on monsoon rains
position as the largest maritime trading port in Europe
complete lack of architectural remains or historic monuments
aciklama: Pasajda Petra'nın kızıl kumtaşından benzersiz yapılarının doğrudan kanyon duvarlarına oyulduğu (carved directly into canyon walls) belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, yapıların doğrudan kayalara oyulma özelliğini doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Artificial intelligence is transforming healthcare by improving diagnostic accuracy. Deep learning algorithms can analyze medical images, such as X-rays and MRIs, with a level of precision that matches or sometimes surpasses human radiologists. Question: The passage suggests that artificial intelligence in healthcare ---.
secenekler: has completely replaced the need for human medical specialists
can analyze medical imaging data with high accuracy and precision
is too unreliable to be used in modern clinical environments
is limited to managing administrative tasks and scheduling appointments
increases the cost of diagnostic tests for patients in hospitals
aciklama: Metinde yapay zeka algoritma modellerinin tıbbi görüntüleri (röntgen, emar) insan radyologlar kadar veya bazen onlardan daha yüksek bir hassasiyetle (precision) analiz edebildiği söylenmiştir. Bu durum, yapay zekanın yüksek doğrulukta analiz yapabildiğini doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Vitamin K is a fat-soluble nutrient that plays a crucial role in blood clotting, preventing excessive bleeding when blood vessels are damaged. It stimulates the liver to produce proteins essential for coagulation, with deficiency leading to easy bruising. Question: According to the passage, Vitamin K is essential because it ---.
secenekler: carries oxygen from the lungs to vital tissues in the body
helps regulate the body's natural blood clotting mechanisms
is the primary source of glucose energy for physical muscles
prevents the liver from producing too many defensive proteins
cures chronic hypertension and high blood pressure instantly
aciklama: Pasajda K vitamininin kanın pıhtılaşmasında (blood clotting) kritik rol oynadığı ve aşırı kanamayı engellediği belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, bu vitaminin vücudun pıhtılaşma mekanizmasını düzenlemedeki rolünü ortaya koyar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Ottoman Empire's control over the major trade routes between Europe and Asia, particularly the Silk Road, forced European merchants to seek alternative paths to the East. This economic pressure initiated the Age of Discovery and maritime exploration. Question: The passage points out that the Age of Discovery was triggered by ---.
secenekler: European merchants wanting to colonize the Ottoman Empire
the need to find new trade routes due to Ottoman control of trade paths
a sudden decline in the quality of silk produced in Asian markets
the invention of steam-powered cargo ships in the 15th century
a peaceful agreement signed between European kings and Asian rulers
aciklama: Pasajda Osmanlı'nın Avrupa ile Asya arasındaki ana ticaret yollarını kontrol etmesinin Avrupalı tüccarları alternatif yollar aramaya zorladığı ve bunun Coğrafi Keşifleri (Age of Discovery) başlattığı belirtilmiştir. Bu yüzden, yeni ticaret yolları bulma ihtiyacı keşifleri tetiklemiştir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Rickets is a skeletal disorder caused by a severe deficiency of Vitamin D, calcium, or phosphate. This deficiency leads to soft and weak bones in children, causing physical deformities like bowed legs because the bones cannot support the body's weight. Question: One can understand from the passage that rickets ---.
secenekler: only affects elderly adults who do not perform strength training
is characterized by the softening of bones due to lack of nutrients
can be easily cured by avoiding exposure to direct sunlight
is a temporary joint allergy that goes away without therapy
is caused by an overproduction of calcium in the child's body
aciklama: Pasajda raşitizmin (rickets) çocuklarda D vitamini veya kalsiyum eksikliğinden kaynaklanan, kemiklerin yumuşamasına (soft and weak bones) ve deforme olmasına yol açan bir iskelet hastalığı olduğu söylenmiştir. Dolayısıyla hastalık, besin eksikliği nedeniyle kemiklerin yumuşamasıyla karakterizedir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The United States Constitution established a system of checks and balances to prevent any single branch of government from obtaining absolute power. By dividing authority among the legislative, executive, and judicial branches, it ensures democratic regulation. Question: According to the passage, the system of checks and balances was designed to ---.
secenekler: give the executive branch absolute power over the judicial courts
prevent any single government branch from becoming too powerful
replace the traditional democratic system with a monarchy
allow the legislative branch to write laws without judicial reviews
reduce the total number of government officials in Washington
aciklama: Pasajda "checks and balances" (güçler dengesi) sisteminin, herhangi bir hükümet organının mutlak gücü ele geçirmesini (obtaining absolute power) engellemek amacıyla kurulduğu belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, bir organın aşırı güçlü olmasını engelleme amacını doğrudan doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Carbon nanotubes are cylindrical molecules made of carbon atoms, possessing extraordinary strength and electrical conductivity. Because they are incredibly light and strong, they are being developed for applications in aerospace engineering and flexible electronics. Question: According to the passage, carbon nanotubes are valuable because they ---.
secenekler: are heavier and more durable than traditional steel materials
combine extreme lightweight properties with immense strength
can only conduct electricity in high-temperature volcanic environments
are cheap and easy to find in large quantities under the sea
prevent electronic devices from consuming any metabolic energy
aciklama: Pasajda karbon nanotüplerin olağanüstü dayanıklılık ve iletkenliğe sahip, inanılmaz derecede hafif ve güçlü (light and strong) yapılar olduğu belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, hafiflik ve yüksek dayanıklılık birleşimini kanıtlar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Type 2 diabetes is a chronic metabolic condition where the body's cells become resistant to insulin, preventing glucose from entering cells for energy. This resistance leads to high blood sugar levels, often managed through diet, exercise, and medication. Question: The passage suggests that in Type 2 diabetes, ---.
secenekler: the pancreas fails to produce any insulin from the start of life
body cells do not respond effectively to the hormone insulin
glucose levels in the blood drop to dangerously low levels
patients must avoid any form of physical exercise or training
the immune system destroys the healthy cells of the liver
aciklama: Pasajda Tip 2 diyabet hastalarının vücut hücrelerinin insüline karşı dirençli hale geldiği (resistant to insulin) belirtilmiştir. Bu, hücrelerin insüline etkili bir şekilde yanıt vermediği anlamına gelir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Moai are massive stone statues carved by the Rapa Nui people on Easter Island between 1250 and 1500 AD. Carved from volcanic tuff, these monumental figures represent the deified ancestors of the islanders, showing highly developed stoneworking skills. Question: According to the passage, the Moai statues ---.
secenekler: were built by modern European artists who visited Easter Island
represent ancestral figures and showcase advanced carving techniques
were designed to protect the island's shores from volcanic eruptions
are made of cheap plastic materials imported from neighboring lands
were destroyed completely during tribal civil wars in the 16th century
aciklama: Pasajda Moai heykellerinin adalıların kutsal atalarını (deified ancestors) temsil ettiği ve ileri derecede taş işçiliği becerilerini gösterdiği ifade edilmiştir. Bu durum, seçenekteki bilgiyi doğrudan karşılar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Overfishing has severely depleted global fish stocks, threatening the balance of marine food webs. When key predatory fish, like tuna and cod, are removed in massive quantities, it leads to an overpopulation of smaller marine species, disrupting the ecosystem. Question: According to the passage, overfishing is ecological dangerous because it ---.
secenekler: increases the salt levels in coastal and deep ocean waters
disrupts marine food chains by removing key predator species
leads to a rapid decline in the population of marine algae
prevents ocean currents from regulating the global temperatures
forces marine mammals to migrate permanently to freshwater lakes
aciklama: Pasajda aşırı avlanmanın kilit yırtıcı balıkları (tuna, cod) yok ederek deniz besin zincirinin dengesini bozduğu ve küçük türlerin aşırı çoğalmasına yol açtığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, av zincirinin bozulması riskini doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Smallpox was a highly infectious and deadly disease caused by the variola virus. Through a global vaccination campaign led by the World Health Organization, the disease was officially declared eradicated in 1980, marking a major triumph in medical history. Question: It is stated in the passage that smallpox ---.
secenekler: is still a major health threat in some tropical developing nations
was completely eliminated worldwide through a global vaccine effort
was caused by a bacterial pathogen that mutated in 1980
was resistant to all vaccines and medicines tested by doctors
was first discovered during the French Revolution of 1789
aciklama: Pasajda çiçek hastalığının (smallpox) Dünya Sağlık Örgütü öncülüğünde yürütülen küresel bir aşı kampanyası sayesinde 1980'de tamamen ortadan kaldırıldığı (eradicated) söylenmiştir. Bu durum, hastalığın aşı çalışmasıyla yok edildiğini doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Nash equilibrium is a concept in game theory where no player has an incentive to change their chosen strategy, assuming other players keep theirs unchanged. This mathematical framework is widely used in economics to analyze competitive markets and business choices. Question: According to the passage, Nash equilibrium is used in economics to ---.
secenekler: eliminate any competition between major companies in markets
analyze the strategic decisions made by competitors in a market
predict the exact inflation rates of countries during crises
help individual consumers make completely risk-free investments
calculate the exact cost of manufacturing new electronic products
aciklama: Pasajda Nash dengesinin, diğer oyuncuların stratejilerinin sabit olduğu varsayımıyla rekabetçi piyasaları ve iş tercihlerini (competitive markets and business choices) analiz etmek için ekonomi alanında yaygın olarak kullanıldığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, rakiplerin stratejik kararlarını analiz ettiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Solar flares are sudden, intense explosions of radiation on the Sun's surface, caused by the release of magnetic energy. These powerful eruptions can send streams of charged particles into space, occasionally disrupting Earth's radio communication systems. Question: According to the passage, solar flares are caused by ---.
secenekler: rapid drops in the internal temperature of the Sun's core
the sudden release of magnetic energy on the Sun's surface
collisions between tectonic plates in deep stellar space
the gravity of distant planets pulling on solar atmospheres
human technologies and satellites orbiting too close to the Sun
aciklama: Pasajda güneş patlamalarının (solar flares) manyetik enerjinin salınmasıyla (release of magnetic energy) meydana geldiği açıkça ifade edilmiştir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) is a progressive neurological disease that targets motor neurons, the nerve cells responsible for controlling voluntary muscles. As these neurons degenerate, muscle weakness spreads, leading to difficulties in speech and movement. Question: One can understand from the passage that ALS ---.
secenekler: primarily damages cognitive memory rather than motor functions
causes progressive weakness by destroying nerve cells that control muscles
is a temporary muscular condition that disappears after physical therapy
is caused by consuming foods that lack essential water-soluble vitamins
only affects muscles in the lower limbs of young children
aciklama: Pasajda ALS hastalığının istemli kasları kontrol eden motor nöronları hedef alarak körelttiği, bunun da kas zayıflığına ve hareket zorluğuna yol açtığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, hastalığın kas kontrol sinirlerine zarar vererek güçsüzlük yarattığını doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Taj Mahal in India was constructed by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his favorite wife, Mumtaz Mahal. Built from white marble, this architectural masterpiece took over twenty years to complete and is celebrated for its perfect symmetry. Question: According to the passage, the Taj Mahal ---.
secenekler: was built as a military fortress to defend the Mughal Empire
is a symmetrical marble monument built to honor Mumtaz Mahal
was completed in a very short time by a single architect
is made of red sandstone imported from Western Europe
was abandoned during construction due to financial crises
aciklama: Pasajda Tac Mahal'in beyaz mermerden yapıldığı, Şah Cihan tarafından eşi Mümtaz Mahal anısına inşa ettirildiği ve kusursuz simetrisiyle kutlandığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, seçenekteki tanımı mükemmel şekilde karşılar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Hydroelectric power plants generate electricity by utilizing the gravitational force of falling or flowing water to turn massive turbines. Because water is a renewable resource, hydro plants provide a clean energy source that does not release greenhouse gases. Question: The passage suggests that hydroelectric power is environmentally friendly because ---.
secenekler: it does not emit any carbon dioxide or greenhouse gases
it can only be built in dry desert areas to save water
the turbines are made of organic and biodegradable plastics
it increases the overall temperature of surrounding river systems
it prevents river waters from evaporating during summer months
aciklama: Pasajda hidroelektrik santrallerin sera gazı salınımı yapmayan (does not release greenhouse gases), temiz ve yenilenebilir bir enerji kaynağı sunduğu belirtilmiştir. Bu, çevre dostu olmasının temel sebebidir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: T-cells are specialized white blood cells that play a central role in adaptive immunity. They are designed to identify and destroy infected cells or coordinate other immune responses, helping the body defend itself against chronic viral attacks. Question: According to the passage, T-cells help protect the body by ---.
secenekler: transporting oxygen and glucose directly to active muscles
targeting infected cells and coordinating the overall immune response
converting toxic chemical contaminants into harmless proteins
preventing the pancreas from releasing high levels of insulin
building protective bone tissue in damaged joint areas
aciklama: Pasajda T hücrelerinin (T-cells) enfekte hücreleri tespit edip yok ettiği veya bağışıklık tepkilerini koordine ettiği belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, onların bağışıklık tepkisini yönetip enfekte hücreleri hedef aldığını kanıtlar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Leonardo da Vinci, a prominent figure of the High Renaissance, was not only a painter but also a polymath. His scientific notebooks contain detailed drawings of human anatomy, flight concepts, and engineering designs that were centuries ahead of his time. Question: It can be inferred from the passage that Leonardo da Vinci ---.
secenekler: focused his artistic career solely on painting landscape scenes
combined artistic skill with a deep interest in science and engineering
was unable to publish his notebooks due to church regulations
rejected realistic representations in favor of abstract art forms
was a scientist who refused to paint religious subjects in Italy
aciklama: Pasajda Leonardo'nun sadece bir ressam değil, aynı zamanda anatomi, uçuş ve mühendislik tasarımları içeren defterleri olan bir bilgin (polymath) olduğu söylenmiştir. Bu, onun sanat becerisini bilim ve mühendislikle birleştirdiğini gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Amazon Rainforest plays a critical role in the global carbon cycle by absorbing billions of tons of atmospheric carbon dioxide every year. However, deforestation driven by agriculture is reducing this capacity, accelerating the pace of climate change. Question: According to the passage, deforestation in the Amazon is dangerous because it ---.
secenekler: increases the total land area available for sustainable farming
reduces the forest's ability to absorb atmospheric carbon dioxide
prevents the local soil from absorbing any water-soluble nutrients
causes sudden drops in global sea levels during summer months
destroys the natural geothermal energy resources in the region
aciklama: Pasajda ormansızlaşmanın (deforestation) yağmur ormanlarının karbondioksit emme kapasitesini azalttığı ve küresel iklim değişikliğini hızlandırdığı belirtilmiştir. Bu yüzden ormansızlaşma, karbon emilim kapasitesini düşürmesi yönüyle tehlikelidir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Bulimia nervosa is an eating disorder characterized by episodes of binge eating followed by compensatory behaviors, such as self-induced vomiting. This cycle can cause severe electrolyte imbalances, damaging the cardiovascular and digestive systems over time. Question: According to the passage, bulimia nervosa is harmful to health because it ---.
secenekler: causes the body to absorb too much calcium from dairy products
can lead to serious cardiovascular and digestive damage
is a temporary stomach infection that cannot be cured with drugs
prevents the patient from ever feeling any physical hunger
only affects individuals who have active genetic diabetes
aciklama: Pasajda bu rahatsızlığın yol açtığı elektrolit dengesizliği döngüsünün zamanla kalp-damar ve sindirim sistemine ciddi zarar verebileceği belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, seçenekteki zararları doğrudan doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Bluetooth technology operates by using short-range radio waves to transmit data between electronic devices without cables. Because it consumes very little power, Bluetooth is ideal for connecting wireless headphones, smartwatches, and medical devices to phones. Question: According to the passage, Bluetooth technology is suitable for portable devices because it ---.
secenekler: relies on satellite connections to transmit data across countries
operates on low power and uses short-range radio frequencies
is immune to any form of physical barriers or electronic interference
can transmit high amounts of data much faster than optical fibers
does not require any hardware sensors to function on smartphones
aciklama: Pasajda Bluetooth'un kısa mesafe radyo dalgaları kullandığı ve çok az güç tükettiği (consumes very little power) belirtilmiştir. Bu iki özellik, onu taşınabilir cihazlar için uygun hale getirir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: In ancient Rome, gladiator contests were highly organized public spectacles. Often fighting to the death, gladiators were typically slaves or war captives trained in specialized schools to provide entertainment for Roman citizens and emperors. Question: It can be learned from the passage that Roman gladiators ---.
secenekler: were wealthy citizens who volunteered to fight for prestige
were mostly slaves or captives trained for public entertainment
fought only in small private arenas far from Rome's capital
were banned from using any real weapons during contests
established their own independent schools to teach trade skills
aciklama: Pasajda gladyatörlerin genellikle köleler veya savaş esirleri (slaves or war captives) olduğu ve halkı eğlendirmek üzere özel okullarda eğitildikleri ifade edilmektedir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The deep-sea anglerfish is adapted to the complete darkness of the midnight zone using a bioluminescent lure. This glowing bulb, filled with symbiotic bacteria, hangs in front of its mouth, attracting prey that are easily captured in the dark. Question: According to the passage, the anglerfish uses bioluminescence to ---.
secenekler: warm itself up in the freezing temperatures of deep oceans
attract prey toward its mouth in the dark deep-sea environment
scare away larger predators that might try to consume it
perform photosynthesis in the absence of sunlight on the seafloor
communicate with scientists who are exploring deep-sea trenches
aciklama: Pasajda fener balığının (anglerfish) ağzının önünde sarkan parıldayan ampulü avlarını çekmek (attracting prey) amacıyla kullandığı söylenmiştir. Dolayısıyla parıltı, karanlık ortamda avı çekmek için kullanılır.

soru_metni: Paragraph: High dietary intake of sodium, commonly consumed through table salt and processed foods, is a primary risk factor for hypertension. Excessive sodium causes the body to retain water, increasing blood volume and raising pressure on artery walls. Question: The passage explains that consuming too much sodium can raise blood pressure by ---.
secenekler: reducing the total amount of water retained by the body
increasing blood volume due to water retention in tissues
directly destroying the physical structure of heart muscles
preventing the kidneys from filtering any metabolic wastes
forcing the liver to produce high levels of digestive enzymes
aciklama: Pasajda aşırı sodyum tüketiminin vücudun su tutmasına (retain water), bunun da kan hacmini artırarak damar duvarlarındaki basıncı (tansiyonu) yükseltmesine yol açtığı söylenmiştir. Bu durum, su tutulumunun kan hacmini artırdığını doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Green roofs are rooftops covered with vegetation and soil, designed to improve urban sustainability. By absorbing rainwater, providing natural insulation, and reducing the urban heat island effect, they help cities manage temperatures and runoffs. Question: According to the passage, green roofs benefit cities by ---.
secenekler: replacing the need for concrete building foundations entirely
managing rainwater and reducing temperatures in urban areas
being much cheaper to build than traditional tile rooftops
absorbing oxygen and releasing carbon dioxide into the air
attracting invasive bird species to nest in downtown areas
aciklama: Pasajda yeşil çatıların yağmur suyunu emdiği, yalıtım sağladığı ve kentsel ısı adası etkisini azalttığı (sıcaklığı düşürdüğü) söylenmiştir. Bu durum, yağmur suyunu yönetip kent sıcaklıklarını düşürme faydasını doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Nuclear fission is the reaction where the nucleus of a heavy atom, like uranium, splits into smaller parts, releasing immense amounts of energy. This process is the foundation of traditional nuclear power plants, providing carbon-free electricity. Question: According to the passage, nuclear fission ---.
secenekler: combines light atomic nuclei to form a heavier element
involves the splitting of heavy atomic nuclei to release energy
produces higher carbon emissions than traditional coal plants
was recently developed to replace renewable wind turbines
is a natural reaction that only occurs on the surface of the Sun
aciklama: Pasajda nükleer fisyonun (fission), uranyum gibi ağır bir atomun çekirdeğinin daha küçük parçalara bölünerek büyük enerji salması (splits into smaller parts) süreci olduğu belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, ağır çekirdeklerin bölünmesi tanımını doğrudan karşılar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Aerobic exercise, such as running or swimming, increases heart rate and oxygen consumption over an extended period. This form of physical training strengthens the cardiovascular system, improves lung capacity, and boosts metabolic health. Question: The passage suggests that regular aerobic exercise ---.
secenekler: should be avoided by people who want to lose weight safely
enhances cardiovascular strength and improves lung capacity
is less effective for metabolism than complete physical rest
can cause chronic inflammation in the blood vessels of adults
only benefits muscles in the upper part of the human body
aciklama: Pasajda aerobik egzersizin kalp-damar sistemini güçlendirdiği, akciğer kapasitesini artırdığı ve metabolizmayı desteklediği belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, seçenekteki faydaları doğrudan doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Photochemical smog is a type of air pollution that occurs when sunlight reacts with nitrogen oxides and volatile organic compounds in the atmosphere. This reaction produces ground-level ozone, which can cause respiratory issues in children and the elderly. Question: According to the passage, photochemical smog ---.
secenekler: is a clean gas that helps protect the Earth from UV radiation
is formed through chemical reactions triggered by solar light
only occurs in rural areas where there are no cars or factories
can be easily cleared by releasing sulfur dioxide into the air
improves lung capacity and breathing in patients with asthma
aciklama: Pasajda fotokimyasal dumanın, güneş ışığının havadaki azot oksitler ve organik bileşiklerle tepkimeye girmesiyle (when sunlight reacts) oluştuğu belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, dumanın güneş ışığıyla tetiklenen reaksiyonlarla oluştuğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Joan of Arc was a French peasant girl who led the French army to several key victories during the Hundred Years' War. Believing she was guided by divine voices, she became a national heroine before being captured and executed by her enemies. Question: One can understand from the passage that Joan of Arc ---.
secenekler: was a French noblewoman who financed the Hundred Years' War
achieved military success and became a national symbol for France
was executed by the French government for treason in war
refused to participate in battles due to her religious beliefs
ruled France as queen for several decades after the war ended
aciklama: Metinde Jeanne d'Arc'ın Yüzyıl Savaşları'nda Fransız ordusuna önemli zaferler kazandırdığı ve ulusal bir kahraman (national heroine) olduğu ifade edilmektedir. Zaferler kazandırması askeri başarıya ulaştığını gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Chameleons are famous for their ability to change skin color, a trait used for communication and camouflage. This color change is controlled by specialized cells called chromatophores, which contain different pigments and respond to temperature and mood. Question: The passage points out that chameleons change color to ---.
secenekler: regulate their body weight during warm summer seasons
communicate with others and blend into their surroundings
protect their skin from the harmful UV rays of the Sun
signal to scientists who are researching reptile behaviors
absorb more oxygen from the humid tropical rainforest air
aciklama: Pasajda bukalemunların deri rengini iletişim (communication) ve kamuflaj (camouflage) amacıyla değiştirdikleri belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, diğerleriyle iletişim kurma ve çevreye uyum sağlama (blend into surroundings) amaçlarını karşılar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Calcium is the most abundant mineral in the human body, essential for building and maintaining strong bones and teeth. It also plays critical roles in muscle contraction, blood clotting, and transmitting signals through the nervous system. Question: According to the passage, calcium is vital because it ---.
secenekler: is the primary water-soluble vitamin produced by the skin
supports bone strength, muscle function, and signal transmission
prevents the body from absorbing excess fats from meals
is synthesized by the liver to fight off viral infections
can replace the need for oxygen in the cardiovascular system
aciklama: Pasajda kalsiyumun kemik/diş yapısının korunmasının yanı sıra kas kasılması, kan pıhtılaşması ve sinirsel sinyal iletiminde (transmitting signals) kritik roller oynadığı söylenmiştir. Bu durum, seçenekteki faydaları kapsar.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The barter system was an ancient method of exchange where people traded goods and services directly for other goods and services. However, this system was limited by the "coincidence of wants," requiring each party to want what the other offered. Question: One can understand from the passage that the barter system ---.
secenekler: was more stable and efficient than modern paper currencies
required both trading parties to desire what the other possessed
was developed by the Romans to regulate international trades
allowed merchants to standardise the prices of agricultural products
was abandoned because physical goods were too heavy to carry
aciklama: Pasajda takas sisteminin (barter), her iki tarafın da diğerinin sunduğu şeyi istemesini gerektiren "isteklerin denk gelmesi" (coincidence of wants) kuralıyla sınırlı olduğu belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, her iki tarafın da diğerinin sahip olduğu şeyi istemesi zorunluluğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Cosmic Microwave Background (CMB) radiation is the cooled remnant of the first light that traveled freely in the universe, dating back to shortly after the Big Bang. CMB provides scientists with a snapshot of the early universe, supporting the Big Bang theory. Question: According to the passage, Cosmic Microwave Background radiation ---.
secenekler: is a dangerous cosmic ray that destroys active communication satellites
represents ancient light that serves as evidence for the Big Bang
was created recently by massive supernova explosions in nearby galaxies
prevents scientists from mapping the geographic boundaries of space
can only be detected near the surface of warm planets like Venus
aciklama: Pasajda CMB radyasyonunun Büyük Patlama'dan (Big Bang) kısa süre sonrasına dayanan evrendeki ilk ışığın kalıntısı olduğu ve Büyük Patlama teorisini desteklediği ifade edilmiştir. Bu durum, onun Big Bang için bir kanıt niteliğindeki antik ışık olduğunu doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Epilepsy is a central nervous system disorder in which brain activity becomes abnormal, causing seizures or periods of unusual behavior and sensations. While the cause is often unknown, it can be managed with medications and dietary changes. Question: According to the passage, epilepsy ---.
secenekler: is a muscular disease that does not involve the nervous system
is characterized by abnormal brain activity that triggers seizures
is a temporary condition that always develops due to genetic reasons
can be completely cured within a few days using physical training
only affects cognitive memory without causing physical symptoms
aciklama: Metinde epilepsinin, beyin aktivitesinin anormalleşmesiyle nöbetlere (seizures) veya olağan dışı davranışlara yol açan bir sinir sistemi bozukluğu olduğu söylenmiştir. Bu durum, anormal beyin aktivitesinin nöbetleri tetiklediğini doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Indus Valley Civilization, which flourished around 2500 BC in modern-day Pakistan and India, was famous for its advanced urban planning. Their cities featured sophisticated drainage systems, grid-pattern streets, and brick houses. Question: According to the passage, the Indus Valley Civilization was notable for ---.
secenekler: its massive stone temples carved directly into volcano walls
its highly developed urban infrastructure and drainage systems
its complete reliance on imports from Western European lands
having no written laws or structured housing for citizens
being destroyed quickly by sudden tectonic plate movements
aciklama: Pasajda İndus Vadisi Uygarlığı'nın gelişmiş şehir planlaması, gelişmiş kanalizasyon/drenaj sistemleri (sophisticated drainage) ve tuğla evleriyle ünlü olduğu belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, kentsel altyapı başarısını doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: In 1996, scientists successfully cloned a sheep named Dolly, marking the first time a mammal was cloned from an adult somatic cell. This breakthrough in somatic cell nuclear transfer sparked intense ethical debates regarding the future of cloning humans. Question: According to the passage, the cloning of Dolly the sheep ---.
secenekler: was unsuccessful because the animal died right after the process
proved that cloning mammals from adult cells is scientifically possible
was performed without using any genetic engineering technologies
resolved all ethical debates regarding the creation of synthetic life
was limited strictly to replicating the bone structure of sheep
aciklama: Pasajda Dolly'nin klonlanmasının, ilk kez bir memelinin yetişkin bir somatik hücreden klonlanabilmesini sağladığı ve bunun bir çığır açtığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, yetişkin hücrelerden memeli klonlamanın bilimsel olarak mümkün olduğunu gösterir.

soru_metni: Paragraph: A stroke occurs when the blood supply to part of the brain is interrupted or reduced, depriving brain tissue of oxygen and nutrients. Within minutes, brain cells begin to die, making emergency medical treatment critical to minimize damage. Question: The passage points out that a stroke is a medical emergency because ---.
secenekler: it prevents the pancreas from releasing metabolic insulin hormones
brain cells rapidly die when deprived of oxygenated blood supply
it is a highly infectious viral disease that spreads to other people
the patient loses their physical joint and bone structures instantly
it can only be treated using advanced virtual reality simulations
aciklama: Pasajda inmenin (stroke) beyne giden kan akışının kesilmesiyle dokuların oksijensiz kalması ve dakikalar içinde hücrelerin ölmeye başlaması (cells begin to die) durumu olduğu belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, aciliyetin oksijensizlikten kaynaklanan hızlı hücre ölümü olduğunu doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Eco-cities are urban areas designed with a focus on environmental sustainability, aiming to minimize inputs of energy, water, and food. These cities utilize renewable energy, green public transport, and extensive recycling systems to reduce waste. Question: According to the passage, eco-cities are designed to ---.
secenekler: maximize the consumption of fossil fuels in metropolitan areas
reduce environmental impact through sustainable resource management
relocate urban populations completely to rural forest areas
prevent citizens from using any form of public transportation
lower the overall costs of building high-density brick housing
aciklama: Pasajda eko-kentlerin sürdürülebilirlik odaklı tasarlandığı, enerji/su girdilerini en aza indirmeyi ve yenilenebilir enerji ile geri dönüşümü kullanarak atıkları azaltmayı amaçladığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, sürdürülebilir kaynak yönetimiyle çevre üzerindeki etkiyi azaltma hedefini doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Regenerative braking is an energy recovery mechanism used in electric vehicles (EVs) that slows down the vehicle by converting its kinetic energy into electricity. This recovered power is then stored in the battery, increasing the vehicle's driving range. Question: According to the passage, regenerative braking benefits electric vehicles by ---.
secenekler: reducing the total weight of the vehicle's lithium-ion batteries
converting kinetic energy during deceleration to recharge the battery
cooling down the vehicle's engine to prevent thermal explosions
allowing the car to travel without using any electrical power
automatically increasing the maximum speed of the vehicle on highways
aciklama: Pasajda rejeneratif frenlemenin, aracın kinetik enerjisini elektriğe dönüştürerek bataryayı şarj ettiği ve sürüş menzilini artırdığı belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, yavaşlama esnasında kinetik enerjinin geri kazanılarak bataryanın şarj edilmesini doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Saliva is a watery substance produced by salivary glands that plays a vital role in oral health and digestion. It contains the enzyme amylase, which begins the chemical breakdown of starches, and acts as a natural buffer protecting teeth from decay. Question: According to the passage, saliva helps the body by ---.
secenekler: preventing the stomach from producing too much digestive acid
starting starch digestion and protecting teeth from bacterial decay
carrying calcium and Vitamin C directly to the bones of the skull
synthesizing insulin hormones to regulate blood glucose levels
reducing the overall heart rate during intensive physical exercises
aciklama: Pasajda tükürüğün (saliva) nişastanın kimyasal sindirimini başlattığı (amylase enzyme) ve dişleri çürümeye karşı koruyan doğal bir tampon görevi gördüğü belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, nişasta sindirimini başlatma ve çürümeyi önleme işlevini doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The Epic of Gilgamesh, originating in ancient Mesopotamia, is considered the earliest surviving great work of literature. Carved onto clay tablets in cuneiform script, the epic follows the journey of the king of Uruk as he searches for immortality. Question: It is stated in the passage that the Epic of Gilgamesh ---.
secenekler: was written by hand on paper imported from ancient Egypt
is recognized as the oldest surviving major literary masterpiece
describes the expansion of the Roman Empire across the East
was lost in ancient times and has never been recovered by scholars
was designed exclusively to teach commercial laws to merchants
aciklama: Pasajda Gılgamış Destanı'nın günümüze ulaşan en eski büyük edebiyat eseri (earliest surviving great work of literature) olarak kabul edildiği belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, seçenekteki bilgiyi doğrudan doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: The lymphatic system works alongside the cardiovascular system to maintain fluid levels in the body. It drains excess fluid, known as lymph, from tissues and filters it through lymph nodes, which contain immune cells that destroy pathogens. Question: According to the passage, lymph nodes serve to ---.
secenekler: pump blood to the brain when the heart rate decreases
filter tissue fluid and destroy harmful pathogens using immune cells
store glucose and fats to provide energy for physical muscles
produce hormones like cortisol during high-stress situations
prevent the body from absorbing excess water-soluble vitamins
aciklama: Pasajda lenf düğümlerinin (lymph nodes) dokulardan süzülen sıvıyı filtrelediği ve içindeki bağışıklık hücreleri sayesinde patojenleri yok ettiği belirtilmiştir. Bu durum, doku sıvısını filtreleme ve patojenleri yok etme işlevini doğrular.

soru_metni: Paragraph: Restless legs syndrome is a neurological disorder characterized by an irresistible urge to move the legs, typically accompanied by uncomfortable sensations. These symptoms worsen during periods of rest or inactivity, often severely disrupting sleep. Question: The passage suggests that restless legs syndrome can disrupt sleep because ---.
secenekler: it causes severe muscle damage that requires immediate surgery
the uncomfortable urge to move the legs worsens when resting
it prevents the brain from releasing hormones like melatonin
the symptoms disappear completely when the patient is asleep
it forces the body to consume high amounts of glucose at night
aciklama: Pasajda Huzursuz Bacak Sendromu (restless legs syndrome) belirtilerinin dinlenme veya hareketsizlik dönemlerinde kötüleştiği (worsen during periods of rest) ve bunun da uykuyu ciddi şekilde böldüğü belirtilmiştir. Dolayısıyla, dinlenme esnasında belirtilerin kötüleşmesi uykuyu bölen temel nedendir.
